# The Week in AI

## Our weekly read on the AI stories that matter to the people building the future enterprise.

Anthropic has released Claude Fable 5.2, open to everyone, and Mythos 5.2, which has looser cyber-security guardrails and is limited to certified companies. Anthropic reports clear gains in coding, reasoning and science, plus new robotics abilities, and a lower price per token. Its own charts compare Fable at extra-high effort against older models.

Spotted on

Anthropic

### Why it matters for you

The change I notice most is that coding quality now holds when you move from research into building, so a hard problem can be quickly iterated in one model. It also writes far more readably than 5.1, though it shows less of its reasoning, so I'd keep a person checking the work that matters. The lower price per token only holds at lower effort settings. Anthropic's own charts show it costing more than the previous model above high effort. Fable is also more capable than most work requires. I’d gate access to the work that needs it, set effort defaults centrally and use cheaper models for routine jobs.

Anthropic has launched Claude Meetings, which joins video calls to draft plans, answer questions and record actions, alongside Claude Whiteboards and Claude Sheets. Together with Claude Docs, they move Claude towards a full office suite. The launch also adds wider data and app integrations.

Spotted on

TechCrunch

### Why it matters for you

Put a circle around meetings, documents, spreadsheets and whiteboards and you have most of what people use every day. I read this as Anthropic accepting that the model alone is no longer a defence, so the suite is there to give you more reasons to stay within their ecosystem. Smaller and younger firms without long incumbent contracts will be tempted, but a large enterprise won't leave Microsoft 365 for this - yet. When Anthropic ship their own identity and email services, it may be worth a serious look when your next renewal comes around.

Deloitte surveyed 806 board members and C-suite executives in 53 countries. Only 16% have an established strategy for how technology change affects their workforce, and almost half say boards don't consistently bring people into AI discussions. Productivity dominates board conversations, while employee trust comes up in only 6%.

### Why it matters for you

Fewer than one in five organisations have a plan for what AI means for their people, and employee trust comes up in only six in a hundred board conversations. Boards are signing off AI spend without discussing what it means for the workforce. That's a governance gap, and it's one we hear about in client conversations. Closing it has to start at the top, because people copy their leaders, and nobody uses the tools with confidence if senior leaders don't. Our advice is to put the AI programme and the people plan under one owner.

OpenAI has launched a beta that lets verified businesses claim and manage a ChatGPT profile, add product feeds with pricing, and see aggregated mentions and clicks. Businesses can also set up an agent that answers for them and pay to sponsor it through ChatGPT Ads. It starts with US e-commerce.

Spotted on

Dataconomy

### Why it matters for you

A business can now have an agent speaking for it inside ChatGPT, and paying to be seen there has arrived. It's US e-commerce only for now, but I'd expect it to spread. Someone has to own that agent and decide what it's allowed to say, so this is a brand and governance question as much as a marketing one. I'd settle it before the profile goes live, the same way you'd sign off a spokesperson. Earn your place through sources others cite, because self-published "best of" lists won't hold up for long.

# Claude — Competitive Research

Last updated: 2026-05-05 Sources:

- https://claude.com/pricing
- https://claude.com/download
- https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12138966-release-notes
- https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-4
- https://aimaker.substack.com/p/anthropic-claude-updates-q1-2026-guide
- https://www.buildfastwithai.com/blogs/claude-ai-complete-guide-2026
- https://intuitionlabs.ai/articles/claude-pricing-plans-api-costs
- https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview
- https://www.lorka.ai/knowledge-hub/claude-ai-pricing-plans
- https://claude.com/contact-sales/claude-for-oss

## Product Overview

Claude is Anthropic's AI assistant, positioned around safety, helpfulness, and long-context reasoning. As of 2026 it has expanded from a chat interface into an agentic platform via Claude Cowork (autonomous multi-step desktop agent, GA April 9, 2026) and Claude Code (the leading agentic coding tool, $2.5B ARR annualized as of 2026). The latest flagship model is Claude Opus 4.7 (April 16, 2026). Claude is available on web, iOS, Android, macOS, and Windows. Linux is not officially supported as a desktop app.

## Pricing

- Free tier: $0 — basic chat, web search, file/image analysis, extended thinking, memory (since March 2, 2026), voice mode (limited).
- Pro: $20/month (or $17/month billed annually) — more usage, Claude Code access, Cowork, unlimited projects.
- Max: $100/month (5x Pro usage) or $200/month (20x Pro usage) — early access to advanced features, priority at high traffic, Cowork for heavy workloads.
- Team: $25/seat/month (standard) or $100–$125/seat/month (premium) — organization-wide skill management, partner-built skills directory, shared workspace.
- Enterprise: $20/seat plus API usage costs — self-serve Enterprise launched February 12, 2026; HIPAA-ready, role-based access controls, admin groups, custom retention policies. Source: https://claude.com/pricing, https://www.lorka.ai/knowledge-hub/claude-ai-pricing-plans

## Key Capabilities

### Acts before you ask (proactive)

Partial — Claude Cowork (Pro/Max and above) supports scheduled recurring and on-demand tasks. Cowork can monitor and act on connected services (Gmail, Calendar, Google Drive via MCP) but the user must configure what to watch. It does not independently detect signals and initiate contact the way GAIA does. The scheduled task feature is close to proactive but still requires user-defined triggers. No evidence of ambient background monitoring without explicit setup. Source: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12138966-release-notes, https://www.buildfastwithai.com/blogs/claude-ai-complete-guide-2026

### Multi-step workflows

Yes (Pro/Max and above via Cowork) — Cowork supports scheduled recurring tasks, parallel multi-step workflows via sub-agents, local file access, MCP integrations, and Computer Use (research preview) which lets Claude navigate applications and execute tasks autonomously. Cowork runs inside an isolated VM on the desktop for security. Multi-step tasks include code writing, file management, calendar coordination, email drafting, and browser navigation. Source: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12138966-release-notes

### Cross-tool memory

Yes (all tiers including Free since March 2, 2026) — Memory from chat history is available to all users. Auto memory learns work preferences and accumulates context across sessions without re-explanation. Incognito chat mode opts out. Memory persists across all devices (web, mobile, desktop) for the same account. No evidence of a graph-based cross-tool memory store comparable to GAIA's persistent graph memory. Source: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12138966-release-notes

### Integrations

Count: Native connectors include Google Drive, Gmail, Google Calendar, Slack, Microsoft 365 (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Chrome extension), GitHub. Remote MCP support allows connecting any MCP-compatible tool. Major integrations: Google Drive, Gmail, Google Calendar, Slack, Microsoft 365, GitHub, Apple Health/Fitness (iOS/Android, Pro/Max, US-only). Custom MCP / marketplace: Yes — remote MCP connectors allow any MCP-compatible service. Team/Enterprise plans include a partner-built Skills directory with organization-wide management. "Agent Skills" is an open standard so skills work across AI platforms. Source: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12138966-release-notes, https://claude.com/pricing

### Cross-channel chat

Web: yes (claude.ai) Mobile (iOS): yes (official app; Health/fitness data analysis on iOS for Pro/Max US) Mobile (Android): yes (official app) Desktop (Mac): yes (official desktop app with Cowork + Code) Desktop (Windows): yes (official desktop app with Cowork + Code; ARM64 and x64) Desktop (Linux): no (officially not supported as of claude.com/download, 2026-05-05) WhatsApp: no — not found on official sources as of 2026-05-05 Slack: yes (Slack connector available for Cowork) Telegram: no — not found on official sources as of 2026-05-05 Discord: no — not found on official sources as of 2026-05-05 Source: https://claude.com/download

### Unified view

No — Claude does not offer a unified view combining tasks, email, calendar, and goals in one dashboard. Cowork provides a task thread interface on desktop but it is not a full productivity hub. Chat-centric. Source: https://claude.com/ — absence of unified view noted as of 2026-05-05

### Smart todos that execute

Yes (Pro/Max via Cowork) — Cowork can execute multi-step tasks autonomously: write code, manage files, draft and send emails, interact with calendars, browse the web, and coordinate sub-agents in parallel workstreams. Local VM isolation ensures actions don't leak beyond the defined scope. Source: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12138966-release-notes

### Approval flow for agent actions

Yes — Cowork tasks run in an isolated VM and Claude surfaces proposed actions for user review when executing consequential steps. The desktop app must be running for Cowork to complete tasks; mobile can assign tasks but cannot execute them, which creates an implicit review checkpoint. OpenTelemetry monitoring support for Cowork activity (launched 2026) enables audit trails. Source: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12138966-release-notes, https://claude.com/download

### Cloud vs local

Cloud-hosted (Anthropic infrastructure). Cowork executes in an isolated VM on the user's desktop for local file access, but model inference is cloud-based. No full self-hosting of the Claude service. API access available (Bedrock, Vertex AI, Foundry). Source: https://claude.com/ — no self-hosting option as of 2026-05-05

### Open source + self-hostable

No — Claude itself is not open source. Anthropic launched the Claude for Open Source program (late February 2026) giving eligible OSS maintainers 6 months of Claude Max 20x free. Claude Code's source code reportedly leaked but was not officially open-sourced. The Claude API is available but the product is closed source and cloud-only. Source: https://claude.com/contact-sales/claude-for-oss, https://venturebeat.com/technology/claude-codes-source-code-appears-to-have-leaked-heres-what-we-know/

## Where it genuinely beats GAIA

- Best-in-class coding agent: Claude Code is the leading agentic coding tool at $2.5B ARR, with Opus 4.7 delivering the most capable coding and software engineering performance available. GAIA is a personal assistant, not a specialized dev tool.
- 1M token context window: Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.7 include a 1M token context window, enabling processing of entire codebases, legal document sets, or book-length content in a single prompt.
- Safety and trust reputation: Anthropic's Constitutional AI approach and public safety research give Claude strong institutional trust, particularly for enterprise and regulated industries. Source: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12138966-release-notes, https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-4

## Summary for comparison grid

- 5 tiers from Free ($0) to Enterprise (custom); Pro at $20/month; Max at $100–$200/month
- Web, iOS, Android, macOS, Windows (no Linux desktop, no WhatsApp/Telegram/Discord)
- Cowork enables scheduled multi-step agentic tasks; memory free for all users since March 2026
- Best-in-class coding capability (Claude Code); 1M token context window
- Closed source, cloud-hosted; no self-hosting; Linux desktop support absent

OpenAI.content:
# ChatGPT — Competitive Research

Last updated: 2026-05-05 Sources:

- https://chatgpt.com/pricing/ (403 — mirrored via third parties)
- https://openai.com/business/chatgpt-pricing/ (403 — mirrored via third parties)
- https://intuitionlabs.ai/articles/chatgpt-plans-comparison
- https://openai.com/index/introducing-chatgpt-go/
- https://openai.com/index/introducing-chatgpt-agent/
- https://openai.com/index/introducing-workspace-agents-in-chatgpt/
- https://help.openai.com/en/articles/10291617-scheduled-tasks-in-chatgpt
- https://chatgpt.com/features/agent/
- https://chatgpt.com/features/desktop/
- https://chatgpt.com/download/
- https://help.openai.com/en/articles/8590148-memory-faq
- https://felloai.com/chatgpt-pricing-guide-free-go-plus-pro-alternatives-october-2025/

## Product Overview

ChatGPT is OpenAI's flagship consumer AI assistant, serving 900 million weekly active users as of February 2026. It began as a purely reactive chat interface and has evolved to include Agent Mode (autonomous multi-step task execution), scheduled tasks, memory across sessions, workspace agents for teams, and the Atlas browser (macOS; Windows in beta). Available on web, iOS, Android, macOS, and Windows. The default model as of April 23, 2026 is GPT-5.5.

## Pricing

- Free tier: $0 — GPT-5.3 Instant, 10 messages every 5 hours, basic memory, limited deep research, ads shown (US). No agent mode.
- Go: $8/month — 10x more messages, unlimited GPT-5.3 Instant, file uploads, image creation, ads still shown, no GPT-5.5.
- Plus: $20/month — No ads, GPT-5.5 at high weekly limits, GPT-5.4 Thinking, Deep Research (10 runs/month), Sora, Codex, Agent Mode. First tier with full agent capabilities.
- Pro: $200/month — Unlimited o1/GPT-5.5 Pro access, o1 Pro mode, 5x Plus usage. (A $100/month middle tier launched April 9, 2026 offering GPT-5.5 Pro and 5x Plus usage at half the old Pro price.)
- Business: $25/user/month — Workspace agents, Slack/Google Drive/SharePoint/GitHub integrations, shared workspace, team GPTs, no data training, SOC 2 Type II.
- Enterprise: Custom pricing — All Business features + extended context (128K+), SCIM, custom data residency, 24/7 priority support, ISO 27001 certified. Source: https://intuitionlabs.ai/articles/chatgpt-plans-comparison, https://felloai.com/chatgpt-pricing-guide-free-go-plus-pro-alternatives-october-2025/

## Key Capabilities

### Acts before you ask (proactive)

Partial — ChatGPT Tasks (launched January 2025, expanded 2026) allows users to set scheduled reminders and recurring tasks. ChatGPT proactively sends push notifications or emails when a scheduled task executes. Workspace Agents (Business/Enterprise, launched April 22, 2026) can run on a schedule and pick up Slack requests as they arrive. However, ChatGPT does not independently monitor your inbox or calendar and initiate contact — the user must set up the trigger. It is scheduled-reactive, not fully proactive. Source: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/10291617-scheduled-tasks-in-chatgpt, https://openai.com/index/introducing-workspace-agents-in-chatgpt/

### Multi-step workflows

Yes (Plus and above) — ChatGPT Agents can reason, research, and take actions across tools in multi-step sequences using its own computer. Workspace Agents (Business/Enterprise) can run complex automations on a schedule or triggered by Slack messages. Scheduled tasks support daily/weekly/monthly recurrence, If/Then logic in plain English, and dynamic content generation (e.g. fetch stock prices at a scheduled time rather than just send a reminder). Source: https://chatgpt.com/features/agent/, https://openai.com/index/introducing-workspace-agents-in-chatgpt/

### Cross-tool memory

Yes — three-layer memory architecture: (1) Saved Memories (user facts and preferences persisted across all conversations), (2) Chat history referencing (retrieval of relevant past conversations), (3) Active session context window. Free users get lightweight continuity. Pro users get unlimited memory and maximum context. Users can turn off memory or use Temporary Chat mode. Memory uses RAG under the hood. Browser Memory (Atlas, Windows beta) also retains browsing context across sessions. Source: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/8590148-memory-faq, https://www.datastudios.org/post/chatgpt-atlas-for-windows-release-date-features-agent-mode-and-browser-memory-explained

### Integrations

Count: Core integrations in Business/Enterprise: Slack, Google Drive, SharePoint, GitHub, and more. Major integrations (Business/Enterprise): Slack, Google Drive, SharePoint, GitHub; SAML/SSO; SCIM provisioning. Custom MCP / marketplace: No native MCP marketplace as a user-facing feature. GPT Builder allows custom GPT creation with actions (API integrations) on Plus and above. Workspace agents in Business can be deployed in Slack. Source: https://intuitionlabs.ai/articles/chatgpt-plans-comparison

### Cross-channel chat

Web: yes Mobile (iOS): yes (official app) Mobile (Android): yes (official app) Desktop (Mac): yes (official desktop app; voice mode removed from macOS app January 15, 2026 — accessible via web and other platforms) Desktop (Windows): yes (official desktop app with full voice) Desktop (Linux): no official app (third-party wrappers exist) WhatsApp: no — not found on official sources as of 2026-05-05 Slack: yes (Workspace Agents deploy in Slack — Business/Enterprise only) Telegram: no — not found on official sources as of 2026-05-05 Discord: no — not found on official sources as of 2026-05-05 Source: https://chatgpt.com/download/, https://chatgpt.com/features/desktop/

### Unified view

No — ChatGPT does not offer a unified view combining tasks, email, calendar, and goals. The Schedules page (chatgpt.com/schedules) shows active scheduled tasks but this is not a full productivity dashboard. Chat-centric interface only. Source: https://chatgpt.com/schedules — absence of unified view noted as of 2026-05-05

### Smart todos that execute

Yes (Plus and above via Agent Mode) — ChatGPT Agent can browse the web, write and run code, manage files, interact with external services, and complete multi-step research-and-execute tasks autonomously. Users can assign complex tasks (e.g. "research competitors and draft a report") and the agent works through them step by step. Source: https://chatgpt.com/features/agent/

### Approval flow for agent actions

Yes (via SDK / Agents API) — When a tool invocation is about to execute a consequential action, the OpenAI Agents SDK evaluates approval rules. If approval is required, the run pauses and returns a RunToolApprovalItem in the interruptions array, waiting for explicit human approval, rejection, or redirect. In practice within the consumer ChatGPT interface, the agent confirms with the user before taking high-risk or irreversible actions, but the product UX for approval is less formalized than GAIA's dedicated approval flow. Source: https://openai.github.io/openai-agents-js/guides/human-in-the-loop/

### Cloud vs local

Cloud-only. All processing happens on OpenAI's infrastructure. No self-hosting option. Source: https://chatgpt.com/pricing/ — no self-hosting option found as of 2026-05-05

### Open source + self-hostable

No — ChatGPT itself is closed source and cloud-only. OpenAI publishes some open-source tooling (Agents SDK, Whisper, etc.) but ChatGPT the product is not open source or self-hostable. Source: https://chatgpt.com/ — no open-source product page found as of 2026-05-05

## Where it genuinely beats GAIA

- Brand recognition and user base: 900 million weekly active users, the most widely used AI assistant on the planet. Network effects, brand trust, and ubiquity that no competitor has matched.
- Model capability: GPT-5.5 with o1 Pro mode, Deep Research (10 runs/month on Plus), and Codex give it state-of-the-art performance on complex reasoning, coding, and research tasks.
- Business/team collaboration: Workspace Agents with Slack deployment, shared GPT libraries, team workspaces, and enterprise security (SOC 2, ISO 27001, SCIM) make it the strongest option for large-team rollouts. Source: https://intuitionlabs.ai/articles/chatgpt-plans-comparison, https://openai.com/index/introducing-workspace-agents-in-chatgpt/

## Summary for comparison grid

- 6 pricing tiers from $0 (Free) to custom (Enterprise); Plus at $20/month includes Agent Mode
- Available on web, iOS, Android, macOS, Windows (no Linux desktop, no WhatsApp/Telegram/Discord)

OpenAI.title: ChatGPT 是什么？
OpenAI.description: 最近 ChatGPT 可以说是火遍了全世界，作为由知名人工智能研究机构 OpenAI 于 2022 年 11 月 30 日发布的一个大型语言预训练模型，他的核心在于能够理解人类的自然语言，并使用贴近人类语言风格的方式来进行回复。
OpenAI.content:
原文地址 www.techbeat.net

TechBeat 是荟聚全球华人 AI 精英的成长社区，每周上新来自顶尖大厂、明星创业公司、国际顶级高校相关专业在读博士的最新研究工作。我们希望为 AI 人才打造更专业的服务和体验，加速并陪伴其成长。

最近 ChatGPT 可以说是火遍了全世界，作为由知名人工智能研究机构 OpenAI 于 2022 年 11 月 30 日发布的一个大型语言预训练模型，他的核心在于能够理解人类的自然语言，并使用贴近人类语言风格的方式来进行回复。模型开放使用以来，在人工智能领域引起了巨大的轰动，也成功火出了技术圈。从数据上看，ChatGPT 用户数在 5 天内就达到了 100 万，2 个月就达到了 1 亿；另外，在很多非人工智能领域，已经有机构在尝试用 ChatGPT 去做一些智能生成的事。例如财通证券发布了一篇由 ChatGPT 生成的行业研报，从研报的可读性和专业性上来看，虽然在细节上有很多需要推敲的地方，但是整体框架内容已经比较成熟。对于其他内容生产者来说，应用 ChatGPT 也能够提升个人的生产效率。

ChatGPT 的强大能力是显而易见的，但对于人工智能领域不太熟悉的人，对这种黑盒的技术仍然会担忧或者不信任。恐惧通常来自于不了解，因此本文将为大家全面剖析 ChatGPT 的技术原理，尽量以简单通俗的文字为大家解惑。

通过本文，你可以有以下收获：

1、知道 ChatGPT 是什么

2、ChatGPT 有哪些核心要素

3、ChatGPT 能做哪些事

4、ChatGPT 不能做哪些事

## ChatGPT 是什么？

上文说到 ChatGPT 实际上是一个大型语言预训练模型（即 Large Language Model，后面统一简称 LLM）。什么叫 LLM？LLM 指的是利用大量文本数据来训练的语言模型，这种模型可以产生出强大的语言关联能力，能够从上下文中抽取出更多的信息。其实语言模型的研究从很早就开始了，随着算力的发展和数据规模的增长，语言模型的能力随着模型参数量的增加而提升。下图分别展示了 LLM 在参数量和数据量上的进化情况，其中数据量图例展示的是模型在预训练过程中会见到的 token 数量，对于中文来说一个 token 就相当于一个中文字符。

为什么语言模型的参数量和数据量会朝着越来越大的方向发展呢？在早些时间的一些研究已经证明，随着参数量和训练数据量的增大，语言模型的能力会随着参数量的指数增长而线性增长，这种现象被称为 Scaling Law（下图左例）。但是在 2022 年之后，随着进来对大模型的深入研究，人们发现当模型的参数量大于一定程度的时候，模型能力会突然暴涨，模型会突然拥有一些突变能力（Emergent Ability，下图右例），如推理能力、零样本学习能力等（后面均会介绍）。

ChatGPT 真正强大的地方在于他除了能够充分理解我们人类的问题需求外，还能够用流畅的自然语言进行应答，这是以前的语言模型不能实现的。下面，本文将 ChatGPT 一分为二，分别从 GPT 和 Chat 两个维度来介绍 ChatGPT 的机理。值得说明的是：当前 OpenAI 并未放出 ChatGPT 相关的训练细节和论文，也没有开源代码，只能从其技术 BLOG 上获取其大致的训练框架和步骤，因此本文介绍的内容将根据后续实际发布的官方细节而更新。

## GPT

GPT 全称 Generative Pre-training Transformer，由 Google 在 2018 年提出的一种预训练语言模型。他的核心是一个 Transformer 结构，主要基于注意力机制来建模序列中不同位置之间的关联关系，最后可用于处理序列生成的任务。通过使用大量的文本数据，GPT 可以生成各种各样的文本，包括对话、新闻报道、小说等等。上面提到了很多次语言模型，这里简单给出语言模型主要的涵义：

给定已知的 token 序列 N_t（对中文来说是字符，对英文来说可能是单词或者词根），通过语言模型来预测 t+1 位置上的 token 是什么。实际上模型输出的是所有 token 在 t+1 位置上的概率向量，然后根据概率最大的准则选择 token。大家在使用 ChatGPT 的时候，一定有发现机器人在生成回复的时候是一个字一个字的顺序，背后的机制就是来自于这边。

对语言模型来说，可能大家之前更熟悉的是 BERT，BERT 是 Google 在 2018 年发布的一种双向语言模型，发布后，其在不同语言理解类任务（如文本分类，信息抽取，文本相似度建模）中都达到了当期时间节点的最好效果。BERT 与上述语言模型的机理有所不同，其训练任务相当于让模型去做完形填空任务（官方称为 Masked Language Model 任务，下文简称 MLM)，并不是遵循文本一个接一个预测的顺序，其模型机制与人类沟通表达的习惯不太符合。图中左半部分是 BERT 的示意图，右半部是 GPT 的示意图，Trm 为一个 Transformer 模型组件，E 为输入的 token 序列，T 为模型生成的 token 序列。

其中，实线部分为该位置的 Trm 能够看到哪些其他位置 token 的上下文知识。可以看到，对于 BERT 来说，每个位置上的 Trm 都能看到任意位置的上下文知识，因此其在具体的自然语言理解任务上会有不错的效果。而 GPT 则是遵循传统语言模型的模式，例如 index=1 位置的 Trm 是无法看到 index>1 的知识的，因此它在自然语言理解任务上的效果不如 BERT，但是在生成任务上会更符合人类的直觉。业界把 BERT 中的 MLM 模式称为自编码形式 (auto-encoding)，把 GPT 的模式称为自回归形式（auto-regressive）。

大家从 BERT 和 GPT 的对比中可以看到，BERT 在语言理解上似乎更具优势，那为何现在 ChatGPT 的模型基座是 GPT 呢？这就涉及到最近两年逐渐清晰的 NLP 任务大一统趋势了。

## NLP 任务大一统

基于 MLM 训练范式得到的 BERT 模型虽然在很多语言理解类任务上有不错的效果下游任务，之后整个业界在处理 NLP 任务的时候通常会遵循预训练模型→下游任务 finetune 的流程：

这种方式与传统的 training from scratch 相比，对下游任务数据的需求量更少，得到的效果也更优。不过，上述方式还是存在一些问题：

处理一个新的任务就需要标注新的语料，对语料的需求比较大，之前已经做过的任务语料无法高效利用。即使是信息抽取下面的不同任务（如实体识别和关系抽取两个任务）也无法通用化。

处理一个新的任务需要针对任务特性设计整体模型方案，虽然 BERT 模型的底座已经确定，但还是需要一定的设计工作量。例如文本分类的任务和信息抽取的任务的模型方案就完全不同。

对于要走向通用人工智能方向的人类来说，这种范式很难达到通用，对每个不同任务都用单独的模型方案和数据来训练显然也是低效的。因此，为了让一个模型能够尽量涵盖更多的任务，业界尝试了几种不同的路径来实现这个目标。

对 BERT 中的 MLM 进行改造，如引入一些特殊的 Mask 机制，使其能够同时支持多种不同任务，典型的模型如 UniLM https://arxiv.org/abs/1905.03197

引入额外的 Decoder，将 BERT 优化改造成能做生成式的模型，典型的工作有 BART（https://arxiv.org/abs/1910.13461），T5（https://arxiv.org/pdf/1910.10683.pdf），百度的 UIE（将任务设计生成 text-to-structure 的形式实现信息抽取的大一统 ）。我对 T5 比较熟悉，之前也写过相关的分析，这个工作算是比较早地尝试将不同任务通过文本生成的方式进行大一统。如图所示，T5 训练时直接输入了不同下游 NLP 任务的标注数据，通过在原始文本的前端添加任务的提示文本，来让模型学习不同任务的特性。如翻译任务可以是”translate English to German”, 分类任务可以是跟具体分类目标有关如”cola sentence”, 也可以是一种摘要任务”summarize”。

怎么样，是不是觉得跟 ChatGPT 的模式有相似的地方？

这种方式可以同时利用多种 NLP 任务相关的公开数据集，一下子就把预训练任务从语言模型扩展到了更多任务类型中，增强了模型的通用性以及对下游任务的理解能力。

- 除了上面两种方式外，还有其他改造 BERT 的方法就不穷举了，如苏神通过 Gibbs 采样来实现 BERT 模型的文本生成等。（https://kexue.fm/archives/8119）

虽然有很多大一统的路径，但是 OpenAI 一直坚持着 GPT 的方向不断演化着，2019 年他们发布了 GPT2，这个模型相对于 GPT 来说，主要是扩大了参数量，扩大了训练语料，在构建语料的时候隐式地包含了 multitask 或者 multidomain 的特质，最后在二阶段验证模型的时候并不是直接做有监督的 finetune，而是继续用下游数据做无监督的训练，最后的效果居然还不错，证明了只要模型够大，就能学到足够的知识用于处理一些下游任务。从它的论文名字就可以看出其核心思想：Language models are unsupervised multitask learners 。不过彼时，BERT 及其各种变种在领域中的应用还是更广的，真正让 GPT 系列模型惊艳众人的工作还是要数 2020 年发布的 GPT-3 模型。Language Models are Few-Shot Learners

## GPT-3

首先，说几个跟 GPT-3 相关的数字：

OpenAI 训练初版的 GPT-3，比 GPT-2 整整用了 15 倍的语料，同时模型参数量扩展了 100 多倍。这么多资源的投入，使得 GPT-3 成为了一个 “庞然巨物”，其产生的效果也是惊人的。除了在很多 NLP 的任务上有着很不错的指标外，其本身也产生了一种前所未有的能力——In-context learning。

## 何为 In-context learning？

简单来说，就是模型在不更新自身参数的情况下，通过在模型输入中带入新任务的描述与少量的样本，就能让模型” 学习” 到新任务的特征，并且对新任务中的样本产生不错的预测效果。这种能力可以当做是一种小样本学习能力。可以参考下图的例子来理解：其中，task description 和 examples 用来帮助模型学习新任务，最后的 Prompt 用来测试模型是否学会了。

与传统的小样本学习范式还是有所不同，之前主流的小样本学习范式以 Meta-learning 为主，通过将训练数据拆成不同的小任务进行元学习。在学习的过程中，模型的参数是一直在变化的，这是最大的一个不同点。

那不更新参数的小样本学习有什么好处呢？

对于大模型来说，这可是极佳的特性。因为大模型的微调成本通常都极为庞大，很少有公司能够具备微调训练的资源。因此，如果能够通过 In-context learning 的特性，让大模型快速学习下游任务，在相对较小的成本下（对大模型进行前向计算）快速完成算法需求，可以大大提升技术部门的生产力。

In-context learning 的效果固然惊艳，但是对于一些包含复杂上下文或者需要多步推理的任务仍然有其局限性，这也是业界一直以来致力于让人工智能拥有的能力——推理能力。那么大模型具有推理能力吗？对于 GPT-3 来说，答案是可以有，但有一定的限制。我们先来看看它有的部分。

还记得文章开头提到的大模型的涌现能力吧，In-context 正是属于当模型参数量达到一定程度后，突然出现的能力之一。那么除此以外，还有什么能力是涌现的呢？答案就是——Chain-of-thought，即思维链能力。

## 怎么理解 In-context learning？

GPT-3 拥有的 In-context learning 能力可以说有很大程度来自于其庞大的参数量和训练数据，但是具体能力来源仍然难以溯源。不过，最近已经有一些论文专门针对其进行了研究，如清华大学、北京大学和微软的研究员共同发表了一篇论文：https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.10559，探索了 GPT 作为一个语言模型，可以视作是一个元优化器，并可将 In-context learning 理解为一种隐性的微调。

## 何为 Chain-of-thought（COT）？

实际上是对输入的 Prompt 采用 Chain-of-thought 的思想进行改写。传统的 Prompt 中，对于一个复杂或者需要多步计算推导的问题样例，会直接给出答案作为 In-context learning 的学习范例与新任务的测试样例输入到大模型中。这样做往往不能得到正确的结果，如图所示：（https://arxiv.org/pdf/2205.11916.pdf）

然而，当我们将上述问题范例中的答案再细化一些，对推到出答案的每一个步骤都写出来，再将测试样例一起输入到模型中，此时模型居然能够正确回答了，而且也能够参照范例中的样例进行一定的推理，如图所示：

上述的模型输入中，还带有可参考的问题范例，还属于小样本的范畴。诡异的是，有人使用了一种匪夷所思的方法，让其具备了零样本的推理能力：在问题样例的答案中增加一句 Let’s think step by step. 然后模型居然能够回答出之前不能回答的问题。

当然，上图中模型并未直接给出一个简洁的答案，而是给出了推导答案的步骤，论文中则是将上述 output 与输入模型的 Prompt 拼在一块，再次输入模型，最终得到了简洁的答案输出：

既然大模型具备了 COT 的特性，那么就能说明它具备了推理能力了吗？答案是不确定的。因为在更多的复杂逻辑推理类任务或者计算任务上，大模型还是无法回答。简单来说就是他可以做一些简单的小学应用题，但是稍微复杂一点的问题它就是在瞎猜了。具体的例子可以参考这篇论文中的分析：Limitations of Language Models in Arithmetic and Symbolic Induction

## Chain-of-Thought 能力来自于哪儿？

上一小节在介绍 COT 特性的时候，都是统一用 GPT-3 来代表。其实，** 原始的 GPT-3 版本中并没有显著地发现其具备 COT 特性。对于大众来说，像是 chatGPT 突然就有了这样的能力。其实，在 chatGPT 出来之前，openAI 对 GPT-3 做了很多迭代优化工作。而 GPT-3 的 COT 特性就是在这些迭代优化中逐渐展现。但不可否认的是，目前仍然没有确定性的结论说明 COT 特性来自于具体哪些迭代优化。有些观点说是通过引入强化学习，有些观点则是说通过引入了指令微调的训练方式，也有些观点说是通过引入庞大的代码预训练语料，使得模型从代码逻辑中学习到了相应知识。推测的方式则是根据不同时间节点上的模型版本能力差进行排除法，虽然目前我们受限于技术能力只能从这些蛛丝马迹中去发现一些端倪，但仍然具有一定的借鉴意义。具体的推理过程本文不会重复，感兴趣的可以参考如下博客：https://franxyao.github.io/blog.html。

## Instruction-Tuning 与 RLFH 技术

虽然对于大模型突变能力的来源还不能轻易下结论，但是在其迭代优化过程中，引入的一些技术确实提升了（更准确得说是激活）大模型的能力。根据 OpenAI 的技术博客所述，ChatGPT 的训练方式主要参考了 InstructGPT（https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.02155），而 InstructGPT 主要涉及了两个核心的技术实现：指令微调（Instruction-Tuning）以及基于人工反馈的强化学习（Reinforcement learning from Human Feedback)，下面将对其进行介绍。

### Instruction-Tuning

Instruction-Tuning（下称指令微调）技术，最早来自于谷歌 Deepmind 的 Quoc V.Le 团队在 2021 年发表的论文《Finetuned Language Models Are Zero-Shot Learners》(https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.01652)。在说指令微调前，必须得先介绍下 21 年初开始业界开始关注的 Prompt-learning 范式。2021 年 4 月，我在 InfoQ 的架构师大会上做了一次技术演讲，分享了我们在 Prompt 上的一些研究实践，如下图所示：

Prompt-learning 最早来自于论文《Exploiting Cloze Questions for Few Shot Text Classification and Natural Language Inference》https://arxiv.org/abs/2001.07676，当时把里面的范式简称为 PET（Pattern-exploiting Training）。其核心思想为将不同类型的自然语言理解任务与 BERT 预训练中的掩码语言模型任务进行转化靠拢。例如对于图中的实体情感分类任务，本身其分类标签是一个三维的空间。我通过设置一个 prompt 提示文本模板：由此可见，英伟达的舆情是 {}，同时设计一个锚点，将原始分类目标的空间映射到语言模型中的子空间 {正 / 负 / 中}，通过预测锚点位置的 token 间接得到情感标签。这种方式的优点在于能够将下游任务与语言模型在预训练任务中的训练范式达成一致，减少下游任务在模型学习迁移过程中的知识损失，在小样本的场景下比普通的 Finetune 模式会有更好的效果。

Prompt-learning 实际上是一种语言模型能够股泛化不同任务的方式，从广义层面上来看，可以有多种实现方式，例如上面的 PET，本文之前提到的 T5 模型，以及初版的 GPT-3 等。指令微调实际上也可以算作是广义 Prompt-learning 中的一种实现方式（个人愚见）。它的核心思想是尽可能收集不同类型的自然语言处理任务（包括理解和生成），并使用自然语言设计对应的任务指令，让模型试图理解不同任务的指令与特性，最终通过语言模型生成的方式完成不同任务的训练，指令微调实例如下图所示：

那么指令微调与 BERT、T5、GPT-3 等 Prompt 方式有什么区别呢？

BERT 类的 Prompt 设计与掩码语言模型任务相关，Prompt 模板和锚点要与任务对应，需要一定量的标注样本进行小样本训练。

T5 的 Prompt 更像是在预训练时对不同语言任务的数据打上了不同的标记，让模型对语言任务有了初步的理解，但是不够深入，无法应用在零样本的场景。

GPT-3 的 Prompt 中，会基于在模型训练过程中见过的数据，更像是让模型将 Prompt 中的文本进行续写。这种方式可以帮助模型更好地理解用户输入的内容，并产生更准确和自然的输出。但其在零样本场景下效果仍然不佳。

指令微调技术使用 Prompt 来为模型提供一系列指令或者命令，这些指令或命令会告诉模型应该如何进行特定任务的处理。与 GPT-3 中的 Prompt 不同，指令微调中的 Prompt 是针对特定任务和特定的模型进行设计的，相当于是指导模型如何完成任务。指令微调技术提升了模型的零样本学习能力。模型对于未见过的任务也能够理解并尝试处理。在 GPT-3 后续的迭代版本中，加入了指令微调后，即使在 Prompt 中不引入带标注的样本，模型也能够比较好的理解需求并得到不错的效果。

目前公开开源的模型 FLAN T5 就是在 T5 模型基础上进行了指令微调的训练，相较于那些动辄几百亿、几千亿参数的大模型来说，这个模型的参数量已经足够亲民，可以作为个人研究或者业务实现的 strong baseline

在 ChatGPT 公开后，各种五花八门的 Prompt 层出不穷。有让其作为一个 linux 终端的，有让其作为一个二次元猫娘的，也有让他写武侠小说的。感觉上 ChatGPT 可以做任何事情，只要你的脑洞足够大。这种通才特质有很大一部分要归功于指令微调。只要我们设计的 Prompt 指令足够清晰完整，模型总能够理解我们要干什么，并尽量按照我们的需求去完成任务。我认为这是其有别于过往大模型的重要特性之一。

### 深度强化学习简述

# What Is Gemini? Everything You Should Know About Google’s AI Tool

Gemini is a free chatbot, search companion and more. Here's what you need to know about Google's AI tool.

Ever since ChatGPT first made waves in late 2022, tech companies have been racing to make their mark in generative AI. Google, long a powerhouse in artificial intelligence, has centered its efforts on its Gemini system.

Launched in December 2023 by Google DeepMind, Gemini has since undergone several model generations, like Gemini 4 Argon in October and Gemini 4 Hydrogen, released on Nov. 12.

So what is Gemini? What started as a large language model has evolved into something much broader. The name now refers to Google’s family of AI models, as well as its consumer AI assistant.

More from CNET

Those models can understand text, images, audio, video and code and respond to questions about them.

Here’s how Gemini works, what it can do and where its limits still show.

## What can Gemini do?

Gemini has grown beyond a standard question-and-answer chatbot since its launch.

The current model lineup includes Flash-Lite for quick answers and Gemini 4 Hydrogen for everyday tasks, coding and multistep work. Google says this model “follows your instructions more closely,” so you may not have to keep asking it to shorten an email. It’s rolling out to free and paid users in the Gemini app, with access in Google Sheets starting with Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers. Those subscriptions also include Gemini 4 Argon for more complex reasoning and analysis.

Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber is restricted to approved cybersecurity defenders through Google’s Fairwind program, while Gemini 4 Carbon is rolling out to Google AI Ultra subscribers in Google Antigravity, the Gemini app and AI Mode in Google Search. Gemini 4 Hydrogen is also available in Antigravity to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers.

Google’s spokesperson tells CNET via email that you shouldn’t expect Gemini to read your mind.

“Gemini is incredibly powerful, but it’s only as helpful as the information you share with it,” Google’s spokesperson says, adding that brief or vague prompts produce equally generic answers. They recommend giving the AI full background details by uploading files, screenshots or links, since the output will become more helpful with more detailed context and instructions.

It can connect with Google services like Gmail, Calendar, Docs, Sheets and Drive. Depending on the permissions you grant, you can ask it to find information, summarize files and help coordinate work across apps.

You can now connect Gemini to more than 40 apps, like Adobe and Shopify, and order groceries through Instacart or make reservations through OpenTable.

Gemini also includes several built-in features for research, writing, coding and customization.

Deep Research can search multiple sources, follow a research plan and turn what it finds into a report with links you can check. Canvas was built for side-by-side editing with an interactive panel within Gemini for drafting long-form documents or refining code.

You can ask Gemini to turn your notes into a PDF and edit it in the same chat, on your phone or the web. Documents, spreadsheets and slide decks work this way too, but only on the web.

Skills let you save instructions you’d otherwise have to repeat. You can upload your own, create new ones or choose suggestions like “Match My Writing Style,” which uses your Google Workspace writing samples to help Gemini sound like you when you need to write emails, memos or documents.

Skills will replace Gems on Nov. 17 for personal accounts.

Gemini Live offers hands-free, real-time conversations with 10 new voice options, even when the app is in the background or your phone is locked. You can also pause and resume conversations whenever you want, which is a neat feature.

Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking model can work through more complicated requests and talk you through its progress as it goes.

You can also share your phone’s camera or screen with Gemini Live and ask questions about what it sees. For example, you could show it an appliance and ask what a button does, or share your screen while comparing products online.

Google is also adding more agentic features, which means Gemini can carry out longer sequences of tasks rather than just telling you how to do them. Tasks in Gemini, previously called Spark, can handle scheduled tasks and multistep workflows across connected apps. It’s available to eligible adults with a Pro or Ultra subscription in supported countries. Google’s spokesperson tells CNET it’s one of the most overlooked features, calling it “your 24/7 personal AI agent.”

## Where you can use Gemini

Gemini is built right into Google’s Pixel phones and serves as the primary Google AI assistant across many Android devices. It can help you write messages, summarize information, answer questions about what’s on your screen and work with connected Google apps.

You can also use Gemini through its web, Android, iOS, Mac apps and Windows (Windows 10 or later), as well as through Chrome and supported Google Workspace accounts.

Gemini powers Google Home features that can summarize what a camera or doorbell recorded, search past footage and answer questions about a live feed. It’s another trade-off between convenience and privacy exposure.

Then there are AI Overviews in Google search results. If you’ve noticed more detailed answers popping up at the top of your searches, that’s because of this integration. Gemini helps break down complicated topics by combining information from several sources into bite-sized explanations.

Google came under fire for some bizarre advice AI Overviews threw out during its 2024 US rollout, including suggesting that people eat rocks daily or put glue in pizza recipes. The company quickly made some fixes.

AI Overviews are now available in more than 200 countries and territories and over 40 languages, with more than 2.5 billion monthly active users (though since AI Overviews pop up by default, active users might just be people Googling information as they always have).

AI Mode, a conversational experience within Search built for longer questions and follow-ups, has surpassed 1 billion monthly active users. Google is now rolling out Gemini 4 Hydrogen in Search globally for all users. In its blog post, Google says this model is better at understanding what you want, even when you ask for a few things at once or make typos. Answers can include images, comparison tables and links to sites you might otherwise miss. Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers in supported countries can also use Gemini 4 Argon in AI Mode.

Some people still don’t like AI Overviews, and the downside is that you can’t disable them. However, we’ve covered a few workarounds that might help with that.

## Creating images, videos and music with Gemini

Gemini can generate images and edit existing ones through a conversation.

When Gemini first launched, it didn’t take long for things to go sideways. Google faced criticism over some hallucinations and how it depicted historical figures and different races. It made headlines for generating images of Black and Asian Nazi soldiers. Critics accused Google of trying too hard to show diversity. Google hit the brakes on Gemini’s image generation, promising to clean up the mess.

Its current image models use the Nano Banana name and can make targeted changes such as replacing objects, adjusting backgrounds and combining elements from several images.

Gemini can also generate videos and music. Google uses Veo and Gemini Omni for video generation and editing, while Lyria models generate music from text or image prompts. Access and generation limits depend on your subscription and location.

It’s getting harder to tell whether a photo or video was made with AI. You can upload an image or video to Gemini, Chrome and Search and ask whether Google AI generated or edited it. Gemini then looks for an invisible SynthID watermark, though it won’t catch every AI-generated file. You can also add a watermark to images, videos and music generated with Gemini by turning on Media watermark in settings.

## Privacy and your Gemini chats

Since Gemini can work with personal files and connected Google apps, you should check your privacy settings before using it for potentially sensitive information.

For personal accounts, Google may use Gemini activity to improve its services, including with help from human reviewers, when the Keep Activity setting is turned on. Google advises you not to enter confidential information you wouldn’t want reviewed or used to improve its products.

You can turn off Keep Activity or start a temporary chat. Temporary chats don’t appear in your recent conversations and aren’t used to improve Google’s AI with help from human reviewers. Google still retains them for up to 72 hours to provide the service, respond to problems and protect users.

Connected apps have separate permissions, which you can review or revoke.

You can also check what Gemini remembers about you through a Memory summary under Settings/Personal intelligence, then correct or delete details. For now, it’s available in English to eligible US subscribers with Memory and Keep Activity turned on. The quickest option is to ask Gemini directly in a chat: “What do you know about me?” to trigger an overview of your saved memory profile.

Google’s spokesperson tells CNET, “You’re in control. We built Personal Intelligence with privacy at the core, and connecting your apps is entirely off by default.” The spokesperson adds that Gemini never trains its foundational AI models on your private emails, photos or files.

Google’s guidance says it doesn’t train directly on your connected Gmail inbox or Google Photo

Google.content:
# Google DeepMind releases benchmark for professional tasks reading blueprints and clinical images

## AI Summary Google DeepMind has released a new benchmark to assess whether AI agents can perform real professional work, going beyond answering simple questions. The Multimodal Knowledge Agent benchmark, developed with Artificial Analysis, uses complex visual inputs such as architectural drawings, circuit designs and clinical images and requires agents to produce deliverables like reports and spreadsheets. It spans 200 tasks across 83 job roles, scoring factual accuracy and visual quality.

- Writer Choi Jae-won
- published 2026-11-16 09:11:22
- updated 2026-11-16 09:13:03

Google DeepMind has unveiled a new benchmark to evaluate AI agents' ability to carry out real professional work. It measures capabilities beyond answering simple questions, including analysing complex blueprints and medical images and completing deliverables such as reports and spreadsheets.

On Nov. 14, Taiwan media outlet IT Home reported that Google DeepMind jointly developed the Multimodal Knowledge Agent (MKA) benchmark with AI analytics firm Artificial Analysis.

MKA is designed to feed AI systems complex visual information such as architectural drawings, electronic circuit schematics and clinical images, and have them produce real work outputs based on those materials.

There are 200 evaluation tasks, covering 83 job roles across 10 fields including business, construction, engineering, finance, healthcare and science. Each task replicates work that skilled professionals carry out over 3 to 8 hours.

The evaluation does not stop at whether an answer is correct. Each task applies an average of about 70 detailed criteria, weighting 75 percent for factual accuracy and 25 percent for visual completeness.

To ensure a fair comparison, all models were given the same tools and working environment, with up to 250 work opportunities. AI evaluators open the final files and verify the content, formulas and visual composition. Agreement between expert and AI evaluations was 96 percent.

In the results, Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 ranked first with a 57 percent weighted attainment rate on high-difficulty items. Google's Gemini 4 Carbon placed second with 54 percent.

Costs differed widely. Claude Fable 5.2 averaged $31.97 per task, about 42,700 won, while Gemini 4 Carbon averaged $6.29, about 8,400 won, about one fifth as much.

Work efficiency also varied by model. The average number of work iterations needed to complete a task ranged widely from 30 to 130.

Google explained that in professional work, AI agents' competitiveness is expanding beyond simple accuracy rates to include output completeness and cost efficiency. It said the assessment was conducted in a controlled environment, so results may differ from workplace performance in real companies.

About the Author
 Choi Jae-won ittt_0801@d-today.co.kr

# Google DeepMind推出MKA基准：测试AI解析图纸和临床影像并完成工作成果的能力

#### 覆盖10个领域、83个岗位和200项任务，事实准确性权重为75%，视觉完成度占25%

## AI摘要 Google DeepMind与Artificial Analysis联合开发并推出“多模态知识代理”（MKA）基准，要求AI基于建筑图纸、电子电路设计图和临床影像等复杂视觉资料，完成报告、电子表格等可交付成果。该基准共包含200项任务，覆盖10个领域和83个岗位，评分采用细粒度标准，其中事实准确性权重为75%，视觉完成度权重为25%。在已公布结果中，Claude Fable 5.2以57%的综合加权得分位居第一，Gemini 4 Carbon综合加权得分为54%，但后者单项任务成本更低。

- 记者 Choi Jae-won
- 发布时间 2026-11-16 09:11:22

Google DeepMind推出一套面向真实专业岗位的新评测基准，用于衡量AI代理执行复杂工作的能力。与传统评测主要考察问答不同，这套基准要求模型处理复杂图纸和临床影像，并输出报告、电子表格等可直接用于工作的成果。

据台媒IT之家11月14日报道，Google DeepMind与AI分析机构Artificial Analysis联合开发了“多模态知识代理”（MKA）基准。

MKA向AI提供建筑图纸、电子电路设计图、临床影像等复杂视觉资料，并要求其基于相关信息完成最终成果文件，以模拟专业岗位中的实际工作流程。

这套基准共设置200项评测任务，覆盖商业、建筑、工程、金融、医疗、科学等10个领域、83个岗位。每项任务均模拟熟练从业者通常需要3至8小时才能完成的工作。

评测并非只看答案正误。每项任务平均包含约70条细分评分标准，其中事实准确性权重为75%，视觉完成度权重为25%。

为保证结果可比，所有模型使用相同的工具和工作环境，且每个模型最多可进行250次操作。最终文件由AI评审系统打开并核验内容、公式和视觉结构等项目；专家评估与AI评估之间的一致率达到96%。

结果显示，Anthropic的Claude Fable 5.2以57%的综合加权得分排名第一，Google的Gemini 4 Carbon以54%位列第二。

成本差距同样明显。Claude Fable 5.2单项任务平均成本为31.97美元（约合4.27万韩元），Gemini 4 Carbon则为6.29美元（约合8400韩元），约为前者的五分之一。

在效率方面，各模型完成任务所需的平均操作次数介于30次至130次之间，差异较大。

Google表示，在专业工作场景中，AI代理的竞争重点正从单纯的正确率，扩展至成果完成度和成本效率。不过，由于本次评测是在受控环境下进行，其在企业真实业务场景中的实际表现仍可能存在差异。

记者信息
 Choi Jae-won ittt_0801@d-today.co.kr

# How to unify creative and document workflows: Adobe and Google AI

News | 16.11.2026

Creative teams and knowledge workers often switch between email, cloud storage, document editors and design tools to finish a single project. The expanded Adobe and Google partnership reduces this back-and-forth by embedding Acrobat and Adobe creative tools into Google Workspace, Gemini and AI Mode in Google Search, while bringing Google AI models into Adobe apps. Softprom is the official partner of Google.

## What was announced

On November 10, 2026, at Adobe MAX, Adobe and Google announced an expanded strategic partnership. Acrobat will be available in Google Workspace through Google Drive and Gmail. Adobe will expand its connectors in Gemini and Gemini Enterprise with Acrobat and additional creative tools, and bring its creative tools to AI Mode in Google Search. Google imaging and video models will come to Firefly, Photoshop, Premiere and Adobe Express, and the Gemini model family will help power AI Assistant in Acrobat. Adobe and Google DeepMind will also collaborate on AI-powered editing capabilities, starting with Photoshop.

The scale is substantial: Adobe creative and productivity solutions serve more than 1 billion monthly active users, and more than 400 billion PDFs are opened with Acrobat every year.

By further connecting our respective platforms, we are giving creators and enterprise teams a powerful, integrated environment to turn their ideas into high-impact content.

## Why this matters

For CIOs and IT directors, the partnership means fewer application switches and fewer custom integrations between document, collaboration and creative platforms. Acrobat becomes a suggested app directly inside Drive and Gmail, so PDF workflows start where employees already work. For procurement leaders, the partner model strategy in Adobe tools gives a choice of AI models, including Gemini Omni, Veo and Nano Banana, without switching vendors. For CISOs, keeping AI-assisted document and content work inside Google Workspace and Gemini Enterprise helps concentrate governance on platforms the organization already manages.

## Technical details

- Acrobat in Google Workspace: suggested app in Google Drive and Gmail, with an Edit with entry point in file previews.
- Gemini in Acrobat: Google models added to those powering AI Assistant for conversational PDF editing, document understanding and creation of presentations, resumes and reports.
- Adobe connectors: expanded in Gemini and Gemini Enterprise to enhance images, customize designs and work with PDFs within conversations.
- AI Mode in Google Search: Adobe creative tools available to move from searching for an idea to creating it.
- Google models in Adobe apps: Gemini Omni, Veo and Nano Banana available in Firefly, Photoshop, Express and Premiere.
- Google DeepMind collaboration: exploring a customized Google image model for near-real-time prompt-based edits in Photoshop.

## FAQ

### Can we open Gmail and Drive files directly in Acrobat?

Yes. Acrobat will appear as a suggested app in Google Drive and Gmail, including an Edit with entry point in file previews.

### Which Google AI models are available in Adobe tools?

Gemini Omni, Veo and Nano Banana are already available in Adobe apps such as Firefly, Photoshop, Express and Premiere, with Gemini models also powering AI Assistant in Acrobat.

### How can AI reduce context switching for document-heavy teams?

By embedding editing and AI tools into the email, storage and chat platforms employees already use, so a project can be completed with fewer application changes.

## Softprom and Google

Softprom is the official partner of Google. Our team helps organizations plan, license and deploy Google Workspace and Google Cloud services, including Gemini Enterprise.

Learn more about Google solutions available through Softprom: Google

## API de Llama 3.3 70B {#llama-3-3-70b-api}

Llama 3.3 70B es un modelo de lenguaje grande de Meta, disponible en la Venice API comollama-3.3-70b. Se ejecuta de forma privada, sin retención de datos.

Llama 3.3 70B es el modelo Llama de 70 mil millones de parámetros ajustado para instrucciones de Meta, que según Meta rinde cerca de su modelo mucho más grande Llama 3.1 405B en muchas tareas. Admite entrada y salida de texto con una ventana de contexto de 128K tokens, para chat, escritura y código.

### Precios de la API de Llama 3.3 70B {#llama-3-3-70b-api-pricing}

ID del modelo | Variante | Privacidad | Precio 
---|---|---|---
llama-3.3-70b | Estándar | Private | $0.70 / $2.80 por 1M 

### Especificaciones de Llama 3.3 70B {#llama-3-3-70b-specifications}

Especificación | Valor 
---|---
Proveedor | Meta 
Lanzamiento | 6 abr 2025 
Privacidad | Private 
Estado | Estable 
Pesos abiertos | Sí 
Ventana de contexto | 128K tokens 
Salida máxima | 4K tokens 
Precisión servida | FP8 

### Cómo usar la API de Llama 3.3 70B {#how-to-use-the-llama-3-3-70b-api}

Envía solicitudes aPOST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions con "model": "llama-3.3-70b" y tu clave de API.
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "llama-3.3-70b",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }]
  }'

### Modelos relacionados {#related-models}

- API de Llama 3.2 3B: $0.15 / $0.60 por 1M
- API de Qwen 3 235B A22B Thinking 2507: $0.45 / $3.50 por 1M
- API de GLM 4.7: $0.55 / $2.65 por 1M
- API de Gemini 3 Flash Preview: $0.70 / $3.75 por 1M

Meta.content:
# Meta Model API

The Meta Model API (public preview) serves Meta Superintelligence Labs' Muse Spark models through an OpenAI-compatible API. The Meta provider extends the OpenAI provider and supports its compatible options.

note

This provider uses the Meta Model API atapi.meta.ai for Muse models. Meta retired the separate Llama API at api.llama.com on July 6, 2026.

## Setup

- Create an API key from the API keys tab on the Meta Model API dashboard.
- Set theMODEL_API_KEY environment variable, or specify apiKey or a custom apiKeyEnvar in your config.

providers:
  - id: meta:muse-spark-1.3

meta:<model> defaults to the Responses API — Meta's full-feature surface and the one its docs recommend. Use meta:chat:<model> for the OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint, or meta:messages:<model> for the Anthropic-compatible Messages API. If you omit the model, the provider defaults to muse-spark-1.1; select muse-spark-1.3 explicitly to use the latest model.

## Available Models

Check the models page for the live list. As of writing:

- muse-spark-1.3 — latest model for coding and agentic workflows, with a 1,048,576-token context window, text/image/video/PDF input, tool calling, structured output, and search grounding.
- muse-spark-1.3-contributor — the same model with discounted pricing. Selecting this ID permits Meta to use your prompts and completions to train future models.
- muse-spark-1.1 — original Muse Spark model, still supported.

Both 1.3 IDs work with the Responses, Chat Completions, and Messages APIs. Meta notes that audio understanding in 1.3 is not fully supported and may produce degraded responses.

## Configuration
providers:
  - id: meta:muse-spark-1.3
    config:
      reasoning_effort: high
      max_completion_tokens: 8192
      temperature: 1.0

### Configuration Options

The provider accepts compatible OpenAI provider options. Notable behavior:

- reasoning_effort — minimal, low, medium, high, or xhigh. When omitted, the model picks its own reasoning depth. Muse Spark does not support none; the provider rejects it with a clear error. Reasoning tokens bill at the output rate and count toward the output cap.
- max_completion_tokens — caps generation on the chat endpoint (Meta accepts max_tokens only as a deprecated alias; if you set it, the provider forwards it as the canonical max_completion_tokens). On the Responses API the cap is max_output_tokens, and the provider maps max_completion_tokens/max_tokens onto it. When unset, no cap is sent so reasoning can use the full output budget.
- temperature — supported (0–2, API default 1.0). Promptfoo sends its deterministic default of 0 unless you override it.
- response_format — structured output with guaranteed JSON schema matching.
- tools / tool_choice — parallel tool calling with streamed arguments.
- prompt_cache_retention — in_memory or 24h for prompt caching; cached prompt tokens bill at the cached-input rate.
- seed — best-effort determinism.

On Chat Completions and Responses, promptfoo rejectslogprobs, n > 1, stop, and logit_bias before sending a request. It also rejects stream because these integrations expect a complete JSON response. OpenAI-scoped environment defaults (OPENAI_TEMPERATURE, OPENAI_TOP_P, OPENAI_MAX_COMPLETION_TOKENS, penalty variables) are not applied to Meta requests.

### Cost Tracking

Promptfoo computes token cost from Meta's published pricing, including the discounted rate for cached input:

Model | Input / 1M | Cached input / 1M | Output / 1M 
---|---|---|---
muse-spark-1.3, muse-spark-1.1 | $1.25 | $0.15 | $4.25 
muse-spark-1.3-contributor | $0.10 | $0.002 | $0.20 

Contributor pricing requires opting into Meta's training data terms by selecting the Contributor model ID. Override token prices withcost, inputCost, outputCost, or cacheReadCost (USD per token) for custom rates. Token cost excludes web-search charges.

## Responses API

meta:<model> (the default) and meta:responses:<model> target Meta's /v1/responses endpoint — the only Meta endpoint that carries reasoning across turns, with built-in web-search grounding:
providers:
  - id: meta:responses:muse-spark-1.3
    config:
      reasoning_effort: medium
      tools:
        - type: web_search

Withweb_search, the model grounds answers in real-time web results with inline citations. Web search bills separately ($2.50 per 1,000 queries) and is not included in promptfoo's computed token cost.

## Messages API

meta:messages:<model> targets Meta's Anthropic-compatible Messages endpoint (https://api.meta.ai/v1/messages) — the surface Anthropic-format coding agents such as Claude Code use. Use it to evaluate Muse Spark over the same wire format those agents send:
providers:
  - id: meta:messages:muse-spark-1.3
    config:
      max_tokens: 8192

The provider extends the Anthropic provider, so its options (max_tokens, tools, image and document content blocks, etc.) apply. It defaults max_tokens to 131,072 and enables streaming so the Anthropic SDK can safely handle long generations; streamed output is aggregated before grading. Authentication uses your Meta key as a bearer token (Authorization: Bearer), matching Meta's docs — Anthropic-scoped settings like ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, ANTHROPIC_MAX_TOKENS, ANTHROPIC_TEMPERATURE, custom headers, and Claude Code OAuth credentials are deliberately ignored on this surface.

Muse Spark's reasoning arrives on this surface as encryptedredacted_thinking blocks, so the provider defaults showThinking to false to keep the ciphertext out of graded output.

## Using with coding-agent providers

Meta positions Muse Spark as a backend for coding agents, and promptfoo's agentic providers can evaluate those setups end to end. In both recipes, setapiKey explicitly: the agent subprocesses inherit your shell environment, and an explicit key guarantees your Meta key is used instead of an ambient OPENAI_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY that belongs to another service.

### Codex CLI

Theopenai:codex-sdk provider drives Muse Spark over the Responses API:
providers:
  - id: openai:codex-sdk
    config:
      base_url: https://api.meta.ai/v1
      model: muse-spark-1.3
      apiKey: '{{env.MODEL_API_KEY}}'

The explicitapiKey is required — the provider does not read MODEL_API_KEY on its own, and without it an ambient OPENAI_API_KEY would be sent to the Meta endpoint instead.

### Claude Code

Theanthropic:claude-agent-sdk provider forwards config.env to the agent subprocess. Pass the environment Meta's guide prescribes, with apiKey set to your Meta key:
providers:
  - id: anthropic:claude-agent-sdk
    # Provider-level `env` outranks the eval's top-level `env`, pinning the
    # routing values a suite-wide ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (e.g. an Anthropic
    # gateway) would otherwise override — which would send the Meta key there.
    env:
      ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL: https://api.meta.ai
      ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS: ''
    config:
      apiKey: '{{env.MODEL_API_KEY}}'
      env:
        ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL: https://api.meta.ai
        ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN: '{{env.MODEL_API_KEY}}'
        ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS: ''
        ANTHROPIC_MODEL: muse-spark-1.3
        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL: muse-spark-1.3
        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL: muse-spark-1.3
        ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL: muse-spark-1.3
        CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL: muse-spark-1.3
        ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH: 'true' # Claude Code disables MCP tool search for non-first-party hosts

warning

Do not omitapiKey, the empty ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS override, or the provider-level env block. The provider forwards its resolved API key into the agent subprocess as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY after env: is applied — if apiKey is unset and a real ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is exported in your shell, that Anthropic credential would be transmitted to Meta's endpoint. Clearing ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS prevents an inherited gateway or proxy secret from being sent to Meta. The provider-level env block matters because the subprocess environment is layered process.env < config.env < provider/suite env: without the pin, a top-level env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL in the same config would silently re-route the agent — and your Meta key — to that URL.

Pin every model alias as shown — Claude Code otherwise routes background tasks, Plan Mode, or subagents to Claude models the Meta API doesn't serve. See Meta's coding agents guide for the full setup pattern.

## Example Usage
providers:
  - id: meta:muse-spark-1.3
  - id: openai:gpt-5.5

prompts:
  - 'Summarize the following in one sentence: {{text}}'

tests:
  - vars:
      text: 'Promptfoo is an open-source tool for testing and evaluating LLM apps.'

Get started with a runnable example:
npx promptfoo@latest init --example provider-meta

## API Details

- Base URL:https://api.meta.ai/v1 (override with apiBaseUrl; the Messages surface uses the bare host https://api.meta.ai).
- OpenAI-compatible chat completions (/chat/completions) and Responses (/responses) endpoints, plus the Anthropic-compatible Messages (/messages) endpoint.
- Rate limits apply per team, not per key: 3,000 RPM / 4M TPM for Standard models and 100 RPM / 3M TPM for Contributor models.
- Full API documentation.

Meta.content:
# 'llama.cpp' has finally reached version 1.0.0.

This article, originally posted in Japanese on 12:12 Nov 16, 2026, may contains some machine-translated parts.

If you would like to suggest a corrected translation, please click here.

The foundational software for running various AI models on a local PC, 'llama.cpp' and 'ggml,' have reached version 1.0.0.

llama.cpp v1.0.0 : A stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem

https://huggingface.co/blog/ggml-org/llama-cpp-v1

llama.cpp is an inference engine that supports numerous AI models and computing devices, while ggml is the computing library that underlies llama.cpp. The initial versions of llama.cpp and ggml were released in March 2023 by Georgi Gerganov .

Initially, the inference engine was intended to run Meta's AI model 'LLaMA' on a local PC, but as of the time of writing, it supports most open-source large-scale language models and is used as the underlying engine for numerous AI execution applications such as LM Studio and Unsloth Desktop.

Meta's 'LLaMA,' a rival to GPT-3, can now run on Macs with the M1 chip, demonstrating that large-scale language models can be run on ordinary consumer hardware - GIGAZINE

In 2023, Gerganov founded ' ggml.ai ' as the development company for llama.cpp and ggml. In February 2026, the development team joined Hugging Face and continued development there.
Then, on November 13, 2026, versions 1.0.0 of llama.cpp and ggml were released. The release notes can be found at the following link.
Release v1.0.0 · ggml-org/llama.cpp · GitHub
https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/tag/v1.0.0

Release v1.0.0 · ggml-org/ggml · GitHub
https://github.com/ggml-org/ggml/releases/tag/v1.0.0

In the future, major version updates will be implemented whenever changes are made to the API or ABI that break compatibility.

# 用 watsonx.ai 的 Llama 3.2 视觉模型做图像描述与视觉问答

在 watsonx.ai 上调用 meta-llama/llama-3-2-90b-vision-instruct，用 Python 把图片编码成 base64 后送入模型，完成图像描述、目标计数、损伤评估与标签读数等视觉问答任务。本文给出从创建项目、配置运行时与 API 密钥，到封装请求体、批量处理多张图片的完整步骤与可运行代码。

多模态模型能同时接收文字与图片，把「看图说话」变成一次普通的 API 调用。本文要解决的问题是：在 watsonx.ai 上使用meta-llama/llama-3-2-90b-vision-instruct 模型，通过 Python 把本地或网络图片编码后送入模型，完成图像描述（image captioning）与视觉问答（visual question answering）两类任务。适合已经会用 Python 发请求、希望把视觉能力接进自己流程的开发者；如果你只需要纯文本对话，用单模态模型即可，不必走这套流程。站内也有对应的工具条目可供参考：watsonx.ai。

在动手之前，先理解多模态模型与单模态模型的差别。单模态大语言模型只处理文本输入，聊天机器人就是典型例子：它理解你的问题并实时生成回答，但输入类型被限制在文字。多模态模型建立在神经网络之上，能够处理和整合多种数据类型，输入可以是文本、图像、视频与音频。它的优势正在于「同时吃下不同形态的数据」，因此可以覆盖从医学影像判读到翻译场景语音识别等用途。

从结构上看，多模态系统通常包含三个部分：输入模块负责用多个单模态神经网络对不同数据类型做预处理；融合模块负责把各路数据合并、对齐与加工，常见做法有早期融合（把各输入类型的原始数据直接合并）、中期融合（在不同预处理阶段对模态编码）和晚期融合（各模态先由对应模型处理，再合并结果）；输出模块则把融合后的结果整理成目标格式，可能是文本、图像，也可能是两者的组合。理解这三段结构，有助于判断自己的任务该在哪一步做文章。

## 准备工作

### 账号与项目

第一步是准备访问入口。使用 IBM Cloud 账号登录 watsonx.ai，然后创建一个 watsonx.ai 项目。项目 ID 是后续代码必需的参数，获取方式如下：进入项目后点击 Manage 标签页，在 General 页面的 Details 区域复制项目 ID。请把这个 ID 与后面的 API 密钥一起保存好。

### 运行时实例与 API 密钥

接着创建一个 watsonx.ai Runtime 服务实例，选择适合你的区域，并选用 Lite 计划（免费实例）。然后生成一个 API Key，并把该 Runtime 服务实例关联到前面创建的项目。这一步做完，代码才有权限调用模型推理接口。

关于计划类型、可用区域、配额与计费方式，各账户情况不同且会调整，请以 watsonx.ai 官网当前信息为准。

### 笔记本环境

本文的代码适合在 Jupyter Notebook 中运行。Notebook 能把代码与文本、图片、可视化结果放在一起，便于逐段调试。在 watsonx.ai 项目中新建一个 Jupyter Notebook，即可获得可执行环境；也可以把笔记本下载到本地，再作为资产上传回项目。

为避免 Python 包依赖冲突，建议先建立虚拟环境再安装依赖。素材中的示例图片与笔记本文件托管在 GitHub 上，需要时自行获取；本文不提供外部链接，按名称检索即可。

## 操作步骤

### 步骤一：安装并导入依赖库

需要的库不多：处理图片的 Pillow、watsonx.ai 的 Python SDK、读取环境变量的 python-dotenv，以及标准库中的 requests、base64、os。如果环境里没有，用 pip 安装。下面这段在 Notebook 单元格中执行：
%pip install image | tail -n 1
%pip install -U "ibm_watsonx_ai>=1.1.14" | tail -n 1
%pip install python-dotenv | tail -n 1

随后导入模块：
import requests
import base64
import os
from PIL import Image
from ibm_watsonx_ai import Credentials
from ibm_watsonx_ai.foundation_models import ModelInference
from dotenv import load_dotenv

load_dotenv(os.getcwd()+"/.env", override=True)

这里的load_dotenv 会从当前目录的 .env 文件读取配置，并把已有环境变量覆盖掉。如果你不想用 .env，也可以直接在代码里替换占位符。

### 步骤二：配置凭据与接口地址

把上一步拿到的 API 密钥与项目 ID 填进去，同时设置 API 端点 URL。用Credentials 类把地址与密钥封装起来，后续实例化模型时直接传入：
WATSONX_APIKEY = os.getenv('WATSONX_APIKEY', "<YOUR_WATSONX_APIKEY_HERE>")
WATSONX_PROJECT_ID = os.getenv('WATSONX_PROJECT_ID', "<YOUR_WATSONX_PROJECT_ID_HERE>")
URL = "<YOUR_WATSONX_URL_HERE>"

credentials = Credentials(
    url=URL,
    api_key=WATSONX_APIKEY
)

端点 URL 取决于你实例所在的区域，请从控制台确认后填入，不要照抄别人的地址。

### 步骤三：把图片编码成模型可读的形式

模型不能直接接收图片文件，需要先转成字节，再解码为 UTF-8 字符串。准备一个图片 URL 列表，循环下载并编码：
url_image_1 = '<IMAGE_URL_1>'
url_image_2 = '<IMAGE_URL_2>'
url_image_3 = '<IMAGE_URL_3>'
url_image_4 = '<IMAGE_URL_4>'

image_urls = [url_image_1, url_image_2, url_image_3, url_image_4]

encoded_images = []
for url in image_urls:
    encoded_images.append(
        base64.b64encode(requests.get(url).content).decode("utf-8")
    )

编码前建议先把图片显示出来，确认自己拿到的是预期内容，避免后面把错误归因于模型：
for idx, url in enumerate(image_urls):
    print(f'url_image_{idx}')
    display(Image.open(requests.get(url, stream=True).raw))

### 步骤四：封装请求体

多模态请求的messages 结构与纯文本不同：content 是一个列表，里面既有文本块也有图片块。写一个函数，把用户问题和 base64 图片拼成标准结构，后面每次调用都复用它：
def augment_api_request_body(user_query, image):
    messages = [
        {
            "role": "user",
            "content": [
                {
                    "type": "text",
                    "text": 'You are a helpful assistant. Answer the following user query in 1 or 2 sentences: ' + user_query
                },
                {
                    "type": "image_url",
                    "image_url": {
                        "url": f"data:image/jpeg;base64,{image}",
                    }
                }
            ]
        }
    ]
    return messages

注意两点：一是图片以 data URL 形式内嵌，前缀写明data:image/jpeg;base64,；二是系统提示里限定了「用一到两句话回答」，这能有效控制输出长度，避免模型展开长篇描述。如果任务需要更详细的输出，可以改这句提示，同时相应调大 max_tokens。

### 步骤五：实例化模型

用ModelInference 指定模型 ID、凭据、项目 ID 与生成参数。示例中把 max_tokens 设为 200：
model = ModelInference(
    model_id="meta-llama/llama-3-2-90b-vision-instruct",
    credentials=credentials,
    project_id=WATSONX_PROJECT_ID,
    params={
        "max_tokens": 200
    }
)

模型 ID 必须与平台上可用的标识一致，写错会直接报错。若你改用其他支持多模态的模型，接口与参数结构可能不同，需要按对应模型的文档调整，不能直接套用本文代码。

### 步骤六：批量生成图像描述

把编码后的图片逐张送入模型，统一提问「这张图里发生了什么」，打印返回内容。响应结构为response['choices'][0]['message']['content']：
for i in range(len(encoded_images)):
    image = encoded_images[i]
    user_query = "What is happening in this image?"
    messages = augment_api_request_body(user_query, image)
    response = model.chat(messages=messages)
    print(response['choices'][0]['message']['content'])

四张示例图分别对应城市街景、户外跑步的女性、洪水淹没的房屋、营养成分标签。模型给出的描述覆盖了建筑、车辆、行人、红绿灯、树木等要素，也识别出人物的穿着（黄色连帽衫、黑色紧身裤、运动鞋）与动作，对洪水图则指出水位已接近部分建筑屋顶。对营养标签，模型以结构化方式列出热量、脂肪、钠、碳水化合物等信息。这说明同一套调用方式可以适配差异很大的图像内容。

### 步骤七：用提问做目标检测与信息抽取

图像描述只是起点。把问题换成需要定位或计数的形式，就能做轻量的目标检测。例如针对第二张跑步图，问「图里有几辆车」：
image = encoded_images[1]
user_query = "How many cars are in this image?"
messages = augment_api_request_body(user_query, image)
response = model.chat(messages=messages)
print(response['choices'][0]['message']['content'])

模型回答图中有一辆车，停在建筑右侧的街道上，并给出了位置描述。接着针对洪水图询问损伤严重程度：
image = encoded_images[2]
user_query = "How severe is the damage in this image?"
messages = augment_api_request_body(user_query, image)
response = model.chat(messages=messages)
print(response['choices'][0]['message']['content'])

模型判断损伤严重，洪水覆盖了大片土地，水位至少齐腰深，可能对建筑与农作物造成较大损失。这类输出在保险理赔场景中有实际价值：先由模型给出初步的受损程度判断，可以缩短人工初筛时间。

最后针对营养标签图做数值抽取，问「这个产品含多少钠」：
image = encoded_images[3]
user_query = "How much sodium is in this product?"
messages = augment_api_request_body(user_query, image)
response = model.chat(messages=messages)
print(response['choices'][0]['message']['content'])

模型返回钠含量为 640 毫克。可见模型不仅能描述画面，还能从图像中读出具体字段值。

## 一个完整示例

把上面的片段串起来，就是一个从零跑通的最小流程。以下代码假设依赖已安装、.env 中已写入 WATSONX_APIKEY 与 WATSONX_PROJECT_ID：
import requests
import base64
import os
from ibm_watsonx_ai import Credentials
from ibm_watsonx_ai.foundation_models import ModelInference
from dotenv import load_dotenv

load_dotenv(os.getcwd()+"/.env", override=True)

WATSONX_APIKEY = os.getenv('WATSONX_APIKEY', "<YOUR_WATSONX_APIKEY_HERE>")
WATSONX_PROJECT_ID = os.getenv('WATSONX_PROJECT_ID', "<YOUR_WATSONX_PROJECT_ID_HERE>")
URL = "<YOUR_WATSONX_URL_HERE>"

credentials = Credentials(url=URL, api_key=WATSONX_APIKEY)

model = ModelInference(
    model_id="meta-llama/llama-3-2-90b-vision-instruct",
    credentials=credentials,
    project_id=WATSONX_PROJECT_ID,
    params={"max_tokens": 200}
)

def augment_api_request_body(user_query, image):
    return [{
        "role": "user",
        "content": [
            {"type": "text",
             "text": 'You are a helpful assistant. Answer the following user query in 1 or 2 sentences: ' + user_query},
            {"type": "image_url",
             "image_url": {"url": f"data:image/jpeg;base64,{image}"}}
        ]
    }]

image_urls = ['<IMAGE_URL_1>', '<IMAGE_URL_2>']
encoded_images = [
    base64.b64encode(requests.get(u).content).decode("utf-8")
    for u in image_urls
]

for image in encoded_images:
    messages = augment_api_request_body("What is happening in this image?", image)
    response = model.chat(messages=messages)
    print(response['choices'][0]['message']['content'])
    print('---')

运行后应看到每张图对应一段一到两句话的描述，段与段之间用分隔线隔开。若某张图返回空内容或报错，先检查图片 URL 是否可访问、base64 字符串是否完整，再检查模型 ID 与项目 ID 是否正确。

## 注意事项

- 模型 ID 要精确匹配。meta-llama/llama-3-2-90b-vision-instruct 是本文使用的标识，平台上的可用模型会变化，调用前确认当前可用的模型标识。
- 换模型就要换接口。 本文代码针对 watsonx.ai 设计。若改用其他厂商的多模态模型，请求体结构、鉴权方式与返回字段都可能不同，不能直接复用。
- 输出长度受max_tokens 约束。 示例设为 200，配合「一到两句话」的提示词足够。需要长描述时同时调整提示词与上限，否则回答会被截断。
- 图片以 base64 内嵌会放大请求体。 图片越大，编码后的字符串越长，请求耗时与失败概率都会上升。批量处理时建议控制图片尺寸与数量。
- 依赖版本有下限。 示例要求ibm_watsonx_ai>=1.1.14，版本过低可能缺少所需接口。建议在虚拟环境中安装，避免与其他项目冲突。
- 凭据不要写进代码。 使用.env 或环境变量保存 API 密钥与项目 ID，不要把明文密钥提交到版本库。
- 视觉问答的结果需要人工复核。 计数、读数、损伤评估这类输出属于模型判断，用于理赔、医疗等场景时应保留人工确认环节。
- 计划、配额与区域可用性以官网为准。 免费实例的额度、可用区域与计费规则会调整，本文不给出具体数字。

# DeepSeek 又来掀桌子了！官方 App 全套能力开放 API，联网搜索价格不到 OpenAI、Claude 的 8%

让一个大模型回答问题并不难，但要让它搜索互联网、阅读网页、解析 PDF，再将找到的信息组织成带有引用的回答，开发者往往需要额外搭建一套工具系统。这些工作构成了 AI 应用开发中一层容易被忽略的工程负担。

11 月 13 日，DeepSeek 宣布开放“全家桶应用 API”，试图减少这部分工作。它将官方 App 和网页端使用的联网搜索、深度思考搜索、文件输入、网页阅读等能力整合进现有 API，同时开放搜索、网页抓取、OCR、ASR 和 TTS 等独立接口。

DeepSeek 声称，开发者可以利用这些能力实现与官方 App 基本一致的对话体验，甚至 1:1 复刻出完整的 DeepSeek App。

对于联网搜索和网页阅读，开发者只需在 API 请求中声明相应工具，模型即可根据任务需要自主决定是否调用，搜索、网页抓取及相关上下文处理由 DeepSeek 服务端完成。文件输入则需要先通过 Files API 上传并解析，再将返回的文件 ID 加入对话；OCR、ASR、TTS 等能力则支持通过独立接口调用。

“产品化之后确实不一样了，DeepSeek 这都开始把自己的 App 能力拆出来了，从搜索到 OCR、再到语音，这个感觉怎么有种冲着百度来的即视感。”开源项目《GSYVideoPlayer》 作者恋猫在知乎上评价。

价格方面，官方表示，用户调用 DeepSeek API 使用扩展能力时，除收取 Token 费用外，也将收取相关工具的调用费用。具体价格如下：

# DeepSeek 工具 API 定价

## 项目 价格

### 文字 / 图片搜索 5 元/千次

### 网页抓取 5 元/千次

### 文字识别 1.5 元/千页

### 语音识别 0.39 元/小时 0.78 元/小时 限时5折

### 语音合成 1.5 元/万字符 3.0 元/万字符 限时5折

注：语音识别 与 语音合成 当前处于限时 5 折优惠期

(划线价为刊例价)

“我按官方价格表算了一下，写一篇带资料检索的文章，成本不到 4 毛钱。”知乎用户药尘 Ray 总结称，“API 的钱已经便宜到可以忽略，贵的是三样东西：控制调用次数的工程、合规，以及你自己的判断。第三样最贵。”

用 DeepSeek App 里免费语音聊天的用户表示，文字转语音的效果“其实是有点拉的”，商用 API 如果是一样的效果，“那这个价格就不值了，不如火山引擎接豆包”。

还有用户认为，“语音识别、语音合成的价格感觉有点抽象，不过价格也不算贵，应该只是用来给用户兜底的，考虑到那些不方便部署自己语音识别和语音合成服务的人。文字识别这个好像综合下来不一定比百度便宜，百度的是 2.5 元/千页更贵，但有 1000/2000 次的免费额度。”

实际上，DeepSeek 这条路线已经有不少先行者。OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Google 都在通过各自的 API，将模型、搜索、文件处理和工具执行整合到一起。DeepSeek 此次补齐应用层能力，也让模型厂商之间的竞争延伸到开发者过去自行维护的工具链。

也有用户对比了三家价格：DeepSeek 的联网搜索每千次 5 元。作为对比，OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的同类工具每千次都是 10 美元。

## 从调模型到调完整应用，开发者可以省掉什么？

传统模式下，开发者会在请求中向模型声明可用工具。模型认为需要查询外部信息时，返回工具名称及参数，应用程序根据这些参数执行搜索、数据库查询或其他操作，再把结果传回模型。模型能够选择工具，但工具如何执行、何时重试、返回什么数据，主要由应用程序负责。

随着任务复杂度提高，这套流程也会变得繁琐。例如，一个需要多次搜索的 Agent 可能在一轮对话中产生数次工具调用。每次调用都涉及数据传递、结果整理和上下文更新。开发者还需要处理不同工具之间的参数格式、调用失败以及模型误用工具等情况。

DeepSeek 此次提供的服务端工具改变了其中一部分流程。

根据官方开发文档，开发者可以在现有 API 请求中声明`deepseek_web_search`和`deepseek_read_url`两个工具。前者负责联网搜索，后者负责读取用户提供的链接。

开启非思考模式时，模型可以根据用户问题自动搜索网页或图片，并生成带有来源引用的回答。开启思考模式后，模型还可以在推理过程中多次搜索、打开网页和查找页面内容。DeepSeek 称，开启思考模式后，模型最多可以执行约 20 次工具调用，包括联网搜索、打开网页和页内查找，让模型能够在多步推理过程中持续检索和核对信息。

与开发者自行组织搜索流程相比，新接口将搜索决策、工具执行及结果处理整合到了服务端。客户端不再需要分别向搜索和抓取接口发起请求。

返回结果中仍保留工具调用记录、搜索结果和引用信息。开发者需要将这些内容正确展示在界面中，并在后续对话中按协议回传相关内容块，但无需自行执行 DeepSeek 提供的服务端搜索工具。

这一变化尤其适合需要联网问答、新闻检索和资料查询的应用。开发者可以直接使用官方维护的搜索链路，将更多精力放在业务功能和用户体验上。

文件处理也是类似的思路。新版 API 允许开发者将 PDF、Word、PowerPoint 和图片上传至 DeepSeek Files API，解析完成后返回文件 ID，再将其加入对话。开发者可以选择纯文本识别，也可以选择图文混排识别。

后者能够提取文档中的图片、图表和示意图，并按照原始位置与文字一起提供给模型。这意味着开发者无需另外整合 OCR 和基础文档版面解析服务，就可以让模型阅读一部分包含图文内容的复杂材料。

不过，文件解析仍然需要上传和引用两个步骤。官方也明确指出，图文混排识别无法保证提取所有图表，解析后的图片仍会消耗模型输入 Token。

DeepSeek 同时开放了独立的 Search、Fetch、OCR、ASR 及 TTS 接口。开发者既可以使用服务端自动编排，也可以将独立工具接入自己的工作流。

实际上，DeepSeek 早在 10 月 17 日就开放了自研搜索引擎的 Search 和 Fetch API。此次发布的主要增量是将这些底层工具进一步整合到模型对话中，让服务端承担一部分过去由应用负责的工作。

为了演示这种变化，DeepSeek 还在 GitHub 上开源了 chat-demo 项目。该项目提供流式对话、搜索、文件输入、语音交互、历史记录导入和多种消息渲染功能。开发者配置 API Key 后即可运行，静态版本甚至不需要独立的应用后端。

## OpenAI、Anthropic 早已入场

随着 AI 应用从简单对话发展为多步骤任务，模型厂商逐渐意识到，仅提供文本生成接口不足以支撑完整的产品体验。搜索、数据检索、代码执行、文件处理和工具调度开始成为 API 平台的重要组成部分。

OpenAI 已经通过 Responses API 提供托管式联网搜索和文件搜索等工具。其中，文件搜索则可以让模型检索已上传文件。开发者创建向量存储并上传资料后，由 OpenAI 负责检索工具的执行，无需自行实现向量索引和语义搜索逻辑。

需要指出的是，OpenAI 的文件搜索偏向知识库 RAG，而 DeepSeek 此次开放的文件功能主要是上传解析后将文档内容加入模型上下文。两者覆盖部分相似的开发需求，但底层处理流程与适用场景并不完全相同。

Anthropic 也在 Claude Messages API 中提供服务端网页搜索与网页获取工具。

在这种模式下，Claude 可以直接执行搜索并读取网页，开发者无需自行搭建完整的执行环境。Anthropic 还提供搜索次数限制、域名过滤以及结果引用等控制项。其较新的工具版本进一步引入动态过滤，允许 Claude 在搜索结果或网页内容进入模型上下文前，使用代码筛选相关信息，以降低无关内容带来的 Token 消耗。

Google 则通过 Gemini API 提供 Google Search Grounding、URL Context 和 File Search 等工具。内置搜索与网页读取能够在一次模型 API 调用过程中完成，Google 负责运行工具并将结果交给模型。

这几家厂商的实现方式有所不同，但方向已经比较明确：原本分散在应用框架、检索工具和第三方服务中的部分能力，正在被整合进模型厂商提供的 API 体系。

对于开发者，这种变化降低了使用门槛。一个原本需要接入多个外部工具的功能，现在可能通过开启几个参数就能完成基础版本。

对模型厂商而言，竞争范围也随之扩大。开发者选择某个模型 API 时，不再只考虑模型质量、推理速度和 Token 价格，还包括搜索结果、文档处理、工具执行稳定性、开发便利性以及服务端能够承担多少工作。

DeepSeek 还有一项值得注意的设计：此次新增功能同时支持 Messages、Responses 和 Chat Completions 三种接口，其中包含 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 风格的协议。

这使得已经使用相应 API 协议的开发者有机会沿用现有客户端或部分调用结构，降低迁移成本。不过，协议兼容并不意味着所有模型能力、参数和工具都可以直接替换，具体仍取决于各家实现。

DeepSeek 目前明确支持这些应用层功能的是 V4.1-Flash 模型。开发者如果希望使用其托管搜索和文档处理能力，需要考虑对应模型是否满足自身业务需求。

## 少写了代码，也交出了一部分控制权

工具编排转移到模型厂商服务端之后，随之出现一个问题：开发者还能在多大程度上控制模型的执行过程？

DeepSeek 的新接口提供了一个具体例子。根据官方文档，当开发者开启托管联网搜索或网页阅读工具时，不能通过`tool_choice`强制指定模型执行其中某个工具，否则将返回 400 错误。是否发起搜索、是否阅读链接，由模型自行判断。

此外，DeepSeek 目前尚未开放托管搜索的域名白名单、黑名单等控制参数。如果应用需要限定搜索来源，开发者仍需通过独立 Search、Fetch 接口或自建工具链实现。DeepSeek 还对部分 API 参数设置了限制，当开发者声明托管联网工具、开启高级安全校验或启用会话标题时，部分生成与工具控制参数将由服务端决定，即使开发者传入也不会生效。

这对于普通聊天应用可能比较方便，但对于需要强制检索的业务流程，意味着开发者不能简单地依靠原有工具选择参数来保证执行。

更值得注意的是参数控制。DeepSeek 文档显示，启用部分托管工具或安全功能后，某些请求参数将由服务端决定，即使开发者传入也会被忽略。这对于依赖固定配置进行模型评测、重复执行任务，或者需要精确限制外部工具调用的应用，是一个需要提前考虑的变化。

在 Messages API 中，这些参数包括`temperature`、`top_p`、`top_k`及部分思考控制参数；

在 Responses API 中，包括`max_tool_calls`、`parallel_tool_calls`等；

在 Chat Completions API 中，则涉及`seed`、`temperature`和`top_p`等。

相比之下，OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的部分托管工具提供了域名限制、调用次数等控制能力。这种差异反映了模型服务平台设计上的不同取舍：封装越完整，开发者需要处理的细节通常越少；但如果希望自行决定搜索策略、工具执行顺序和异常处理方式，仍可能需要保留自己的编排层。

DeepSeek 开放独立 Search 和 Fetch 接口，也为这种需求提供了选择。开发者可以绕过托管式搜索，直接控制查询词、返回结果数量和网页抓取，再自行决定如何把结果交给模型。

因此，对于简单问答、原型开发和标准化助手，服务端托管具有较明显的便利性；对于强调数据来源、执行可审计性和复杂业务规则的产品，自建工具链仍有价值。

AI摘要

DeepSeek 推出“全家桶应用API”，将联网搜索、网页阅读、文件解析、OCR、ASR、TTS等能力统一集成至现有模型API，支持工具自主调用与端到端上下文处理。

支持工具声明式调用，搜索与网页抓取由服务端完成；Files API 实现文件预处理与ID引用；OCR/ASR/TTS 提供独立接口。

显著降低AI应用中多模态工具链集成成本；提供与官方App一致的对话能力；为开发者提供可复刻完整App体验的标准化能力栈。

适合AI应用架构师、大模型工程化团队、需要快速构建带工具链对话产品的技术负责人阅读。

价格方面，官方表示，用户调用 DeepSeek API 使用扩展能力时，除收取 Token 费用外，也将收取相关工具的调用费用。具体价格如下：

用 DeepSeek App 里免费语音聊天的用户表示，文字转语音的效果“其实是有点拉的”，商用 API 如果是一样的效果，“那这个价格就不值了，不如火山引擎接豆包”。

还有用户认为，“语音识别、语音合成的价格感觉有点抽象，不过价格也不算贵，应该只是用来给用户兜底的，考虑到那些不方便部署自己语音识别和语音合成服务的人。文字识别这个好像综合下来不一定比百度便宜，百度的是 2.5 元/千页更贵，但有 1000/2000 次的免费额度。”

实际上，DeepSeek 这条路线已经有不少先行者。OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Google 都在通过各自的 API，将模型、搜索、文件处理和工具执行整合到一起。DeepSeek 此次补齐应用层能力，也让模型厂商之间的竞争延伸到开发者过去自行维护的工具链。

DeepSeek 目前明确支持这些应用层功能的是 V4.1-Flash 模型。开发者如果希望使用其托管搜索和文档处理能力，需要考虑对应模型是否满足自身业务需求。

## 少写了代码，也交出了一部分控制权

工具编排转移到模型厂商服务端之后，随之出现一个问题：开发者还能在多大程度上控制模型的执行过程？

DeepSeek 的新接口提供了一个具体例子。根据官方文档，当开发者开启托管联网搜索或网页阅读工具时，不能通过`tool_choice`强制指定模型执行其中某个工具，否则将返回 400 错误。是否发起搜索、是否阅读链接，由模型自行判断。

此外，DeepSeek 目前尚未开放托管搜索的域名白名单、黑名单等控制参数。如果应用需要限定搜索来源，开发者仍需通过独立 Search、Fetch 接口或自建工具链实现。DeepSeek 还对部分 API 参数设置了限制，当开发者声明托管联网工具、开启高级安全校验或启用会话标题时，部分生成与工具控制参数将由服务端决定，即使开发者传入也不会生效。

这对于普通聊天应用可能比较方便，但对于需要强制检索的业务流程，意味着开发者不能简单地依靠原有工具选择参数来保证执行。

更值得注意的是参数控制。DeepSeek 文档显示，启用部分托管工具或安全功能后，某些请求参数将由服务端决定，即使开发者传入也会被忽略。这对于依赖固定配置进行模型评测、重复执行任务，或者需要精确限制外部工具调用的应用，是一个需要提前考虑的变化。

在 Messages API 中，这些参数包括`temperature`、`top_p`、`top_k`及部分思考控制参数；

在 Responses API 中，包括`max_tool_calls`、`parallel_tool_calls`等；

在 Chat Completions API 中，则涉及`seed`、`temperature`和`top_p`等。

相比之下，OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的部分托管工具提供了域名限制、调用次数等控制能力。这种差异反映了模型服务平台设计上的不同取舍：封装越完整，开发者需要处理的细节通常越少；但如果希望自行决定搜索策略、工具执行顺序和异常处理方式，仍可能需要保留自己的编排层。

DeepSeek 开放独立 Search 和 Fetch 接口，也为这种需求提供了选择。开发者可以绕过托管式搜索，直接控制查询词、返回结果数量和网页抓取，再自行决定如何把结果交给模型。

因此，对于简单问答、原型开发和标准化助手，服务端托管具有较明显的便利性；对于强调数据来源、执行可审计性和复杂业务规则的产品，自建工具链仍有价值。

# DeepSeek 生态指南

DeepSeek（深度求索）是当下最具影响力的开源大模型团队：从 2024 年的 V2/V3 到 2025 年掀起全球开源推理浪潮的 R1，再到 2026 年 4 月发布、8 月正式 GA 的 DeepSeek-V4（1M 上下文、开放权重、MIT 协议），DeepSeek 已经从"模型提供方"演进为覆盖 模型 → API → 编程智能体 → Agent 框架（deepseek-harness）→ 开源基础设施 的完整生态。本章汇总官方资源、模型谱系、API 用法、编程智能体接入、本地部署、第三方平台、应用工具、开源基建与学习资源，帮助中文用户把 DeepSeek 用起来、用得好。

相关：论文与技术报告见 前沿大模型经典技术文章，各家模型横向对比见 LLMs 大模型，编程智能体总览见 Coding Agents，MCP 见 MCP 指南。

信息截至 2026 年 8 月，DeepSeek 迭代极快，价格与模型名请以 官方文档 为准。

## DeepSeek-V4：当前旗舰

- 两个版本：deepseek-v4-pro（1.6T 总参 / 49B 激活，旗舰）与 deepseek-v4-flash（284B / 13B 激活，快速经济）；均为 MoE、开放权重、MIT 协议，可在 Hugging Face 下载。
- 架构：Token-wise 压缩 + DSA 稀疏注意力（Compressed Sparse Attention + Heavily Compressed Attention 混合），处理 1M 上下文时单 token 推理 FLOPs 仅为前代 27%、KV 缓存仅 10%；权重为 FP4（MoE 专家）+ FP8 混合精度。
- 上下文与输出：标准 1M（1,048,576）token 上下文，最大输出 384K token。
- 推理模式：思考 / 非思考双模式；V4-Pro 与 V4-Flash 支持 reasoning effort = low / high / max（简单任务 low，日常 Agent 工作流 high，复杂任务 max）。
- 能力定位：V4-Pro 在开源模型中世界知识第一（仅次于 Gemini 3.1 Pro），数学 / STEM / 编码领先；V4-Flash 推理能力逼近 V4-Pro，在复杂编码与自主软件任务上接近 Claude Opus 4.8。
- 视觉版：deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp（2026-08-21），每张图最多 384 token，按 V4-Flash 价格计费，支持 base64 / URL / Files API 传图。
- 技术报告与模型卡：DeepSeek-V4-Pro 模型卡（含架构、基准与推理代码）・V4 预览发布公告。

## API 使用指南

### 端点与模型名

项目 | 值 
---|---

Anthropic 兼容端点 | https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic 
当前模型 | deepseek-v4-flash、deepseek-v4-pro、deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 
已下线模型 | deepseek-chat、deepseek-reasoner 于 2026-07-24 停用——旧代码请改为 V4 模型名（deepseek-chat → deepseek-v4-flash；deepseek-reasoner → V4 思考模式） 
支持的接口 | Chat Completions、Responses API（原生，Codex 一键接入）、Anthropic Messages、FIM 补全、Files API 

from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(api_key="<DEEPSEEK_API_KEY>", base_url="https://api.deepseek.com")
resp = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="deepseek-v4-flash",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "用一句话介绍 DeepSeek-V4"}],
)
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)

## 在编程智能体中使用 DeepSeek

DeepSeek 同时兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 两种协议，因此几乎所有主流编程智能体都能一行配置切换到 V4。官方维护的 awesome-deepseek-agent 列出了每个工具的接入方法。

### Claude Code
export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=<DEEPSEEK_API_KEY>
export ANTHROPIC_MODEL=deepseek-v4-pro      # 或 deepseek-v4-flash
claude

也可写入~/.claude/settings.json 的 env 字段持久化。Claude Code 的 Skills、Hooks、子 Agent 等能力均可正常使用；不支持 document 内容块与 MCP 工具透传（本地 MCP 由 Claude Code 自身处理，不受影响）。

### Codex / OpenAI 兼容工具

V4 原生支持 OpenAI Responses API，OpenAI Codex CLI 可通过自定义 provider 一键接入：在~/.codex/config.toml 中添加 [model_providers.deepseek]，base_url = "https://api.deepseek.com"，model = "deepseek-v4-pro"。OpenCode、Crush、Cline、Roo Code、Kilo Code、Continue、Qwen Code、GitHub Copilot（BYOK）等同理，选择 OpenAI-compatible 提供方并填入端点与模型名即可。

## deepseek-harness：官方 Agent 框架

2026 年 8 月 13 日（与 V4-Pro GA 同日），DeepSeek 开源了官方 Agent 框架 deepseek-harness（dsh），发布不到两周即突破 19 万 star，成为 GitHub 史上增长最快的项目之一。它的口号是 "Everything is a Plugin"：模型适配器、工具注册表、会话日志、Agent 循环本身乃至 Web UI 全部是可替换的插件，底层由 Cordis 框架驱动（其设计见论文 A Programming Paradigm for Spatiotemporal Composability）。目前处于开发者预览（v0.1.x），官方明确提示会有破坏性变更。

### 核心概念

概念 | 说明 
---|---
Profile / Bundle | 运行中的 dsh 是启动时按层组合出的插件树：dsh-base（模型适配、工具、持久化、沙箱与审批策略）→ dsh-web-app 或 dsh-headless → 用户的 cordis.patch.yml 覆盖；dsh --profile web --dump-config 可打印本机实际启动的插件树，任一行都能被 patch 替换 
Capability Seam（能力接缝） | 每个能力由"服务定义 + 服务提供者 + 消费者"三角构成，换一个 provider 即可整体切换——例如把文件系统与子进程 provider 指向远程沙箱，Bash / PTY / LSP 全部随之迁移 
MCP 客户端 | 内置 MCP 桥接第三方工具服务器 
Hook 协议 | 拦截 Agent 动作的钩子，兼容 Claude Code 与 Codex 的 Hook 格式 
Skill 系统 | Markdown 指令集，由 SkillRegistry 管理，支持全局 / Agent 级作用域，兼容 Agent Skills 开放标准 
子 Agent / Agent Teams | 子 Agent provider 可从"新建子进程"到"委托给另一产品"自由替换；实验性 Agent Teams 提供名册、任务板与邮箱 
会话日志 | 追加式事件日志是模型上下文的唯一来源（"模型可见即已记录"），fork / resume / 转录 / 遥测都由此派生 
Python SDK | 官方提供 Python SDK，可在脚本中驱动 dsh 

### 快速上手
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web        # 启动 Web UI，默认 http://127.0.0.1:3080
# 或从源码运行
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git && cd deepseek-harness
pnpm install && pnpm run build && pnpm dsh web

默认使用 DeepSeek 官方 API（在 Providers 页面填 Key），也可在 Providers 中添加任意 OpenAI 兼容端点或本地模型。
