DeepSeek.content:
# DeepSeek

DeepSeek provides an OpenAI-compatible chat API. The provider accepts OpenAI chat options; DeepSeek determines which options each model supports.

## Setup

- Get an API key from the DeepSeek Platform
- SetDEEPSEEK_API_KEY environment variable or specify apiKey in your config

## Configuration

Basic configuration example:
providers:
  - id: deepseek:deepseek-flash
    config:
      max_tokens: 4000
      passthrough:
        thinking: { type: disabled }

  - id: deepseek:deepseek-v4-pro
    config:
      max_tokens: 8192
      showThinking: true
      passthrough:
        thinking:
          type: enabled
        reasoning_effort: high

### Configuration Options

- temperature
- max_tokens
- reasoning_effort - none disables thinking; low, high, and max enable it. DeepSeek defaults to high. When neither max_tokens nor OPENAI_MAX_TOKENS is set, Promptfoo uses DeepSeek's output budget.
- cost, inputCost, outputCost, cacheReadCost - Set cost estimates in USD per token. inputCost and outputCost take precedence over cost; cacheReadCost sets a separate cached-input rate.
- top_p, presence_penalty, frequency_penalty
- showThinking - Control whether reasoning content is included in the output (default: true, applies to thinking-capable models)

Promptfoo requests complete responses; this provider does not support streaming.

## Available Models

DeepSeek listsdeepseek-flash and deepseek-v4-pro in its model catalog. The older deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner IDs are retired. The shorthand deepseek: uses deepseek-flash with thinking disabled; use the full ID for DeepSeek's default thinking mode.

### deepseek-flash

Usedeepseek:deepseek-flash for V4.1 Flash, which supports text and image inputs. The older deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp IDs route to the same model. It supports a 1M-token context window and up to 384K output tokens.

### deepseek-v4-pro

V4 Pro supports text input, thinking and non-thinking modes, a 1M-token context window, and up to 384K output tokens.

DeepSeek charges different peak and off-peak rates. Promptfoo estimates current models at peak rates: Flash costs $0.30 input, $0.006 cached input, and $1.20 output per million tokens; Pro costs $1.32, $0.044, and $3.96 respectively. Off-peak rates are half these amounts. SetinputCost, outputCost, and cacheReadCost in USD per token to override the estimate using the current rates. Promptfoo does not infer the billing period or Chinese public holidays.

warning

Sampling support differs by mode.temperature has no effect in thinking mode. top_p only affects thinking mode and values below 0.95 are treated as 0.95. See the Chat Completions reference for parameter limits.

## Example Usage

Compare DeepSeek with OpenAI on a reasoning task:

promptfooconfig.yaml
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://promptfoo.dev/config-schema.json
providers:
  - id: deepseek:deepseek-v4-pro
    config:
      max_tokens: 8000
      showThinking: true # Include reasoning content in output (default)
  - id: openai:gpt-5.4-mini
    config:
      reasoning_effort: medium

prompts:
  - 'Solve this step by step: {{math_problem}}'

tests:
  - vars:
      math_problem: 'What is the derivative of x^3 + 2x with respect to x?'

### Controlling Reasoning Output

SetshowThinking: false to exclude reasoning content from the output:
providers:
  - id: deepseek:deepseek-v4-pro
    config:
      showThinking: false # Hide reasoning content from output
      passthrough:
        thinking:
          type: enabled

WithshowThinking: true (the default), the output includes reasoning when DeepSeek returns it:
Thinking: <reasoning content>

<final answer>

WithshowThinking: false, assertions see only the final answer. This option does not turn off thinking at the API; use config.passthrough.thinking: { type: disabled } for that.

## API Details

- Base URL:https://api.deepseek.com/v1
- OpenAI-compatible API format
- DeepSeek API documentation

## See Also

- OpenAI Provider - Compatible configuration options
- Historical MMLU comparison - Replace its retired provider IDs with the current IDs shown above before running it.

# 98:DeepSeek全家桶来了, Agent 平台什么时候失业？

李福春

发布于 2026-11-16 14:22:33

发布于 2026-11-16 14:22:33

10

举报

概述

DeepSeek 把联网搜索、深度思考搜索、文件输入、链接阅读与基础安全校验收进会话接口，工具调用和上下文拼接由服务端完成，Search、Fetch、OCR、A

01、现场：工具链被收进接口之后

DeepSeek 在 2026 年 11 月 13 日发布全家桶应用 API。

按官方说明，deepseek-flash 在 Messages、Responses 与 Chat Completions 三类接口中支持联网搜索、深度思考搜索、文件输入、阅读链接和基础安全校验。

搜索工具名为 deepseek_web_search，阅读链接工具名为 deepseek_read_url。工具调用与上下文拼接由服务端完成，调用方不必自己编排“先搜再读再拼”的循环。

Search、Fetch、OCR、ASR、TTS 还能作为独立接口单独调用。扩展能力除 Token 费用外，另收工具调用费用。

团队里第一反应很直接：搜索、抓取、文件解析都被服务商封装，我们那套 Agent 平台是不是要失业了？

我的判断是，失业的不是平台，是平台里那层“工具适配”。真正难的部分从来没被封装掉。

02、拆题：被替代的是哪一层

先把“Agent 平台”拆开看。它通常包含四层：模型接入、工具适配、编排运行时、企业控制面。

模型接入层做协议转换、密钥管理、多模型路由。工具适配层把搜索、抓取、OCR 包成统一函数。编排层管多步循环与状态。控制面管权限、审计、预算、评测。

全家桶直接吃掉的是工具适配层的大部分，以及编排层里“搜索加阅读”这类标准循环。这部分自建成本高、差异化低，交给服务商合理。

控制面反而更值钱了。因为工具越强，一次调用能触达的外部数据越多，越权和数据外泄的后果越重。

需要区分两类接口。会话接口是 Messages、Responses、Chat Completions，工具调用在会话内完成。独立接口是 Search、Fetch、OCR、ASR、TTS，按能力单独计费。

也要区分官方功能与企业治理。官方提供的是基础安全校验，不等于企业内容安全审核、登记与 AI 标识义务的履行。对外服务的主体责任仍在企业侧。

03、原理：服务端拼接改变了什么

传统自建链路里，模型只负责决策，搜索、抓取、解析、截断、拼上下文都由应用完成。每一步都可观测，也都可能出错。

全家桶把这段循环移到服务端。好处是链路短、适配少、标准场景上线快。代价是中间过程对调用方不再完全透明。

透明度的损失体现在三处。第一，检索了什么、读到了什么，调用方只能从返回结果和工具事件里推断。第二，上下文如何截断与排序，由服务端策略决定。第三，工具调用单独计费，成本结构比纯 Token 更复杂。

这不构成反对理由，而是设计约束。控制面必须补上可观测性：记录工具名、入参摘要、返回摘要、耗时与计费单元。

部署边界图https://developer.qcloudimg.com/http-save/yehe-9261324/20fedbdb6f81e6efea30d119e2eb967e.png

部署边界要画清楚。左侧是用户与业务 Agent，中间是企业模型网关与控制面，右侧是 DeepSeek 会话接口与独立工具接口。

网关是唯一出口。业务服务不直连模型，密钥不下发到业务进程。这样租户隔离、预算和审计才有落点。

04、取舍：自建还是托管

自建工具链的优点是可控：抓取策略、解析规则、缓存、脱敏都能自己定。代价是维护成本高，站点改版、反爬变化、文件格式兼容都要人跟。

托管工具链的优点是上线快、标准场景覆盖好、少写适配代码。代价是策略黑盒、计费叠加、异常时排查依赖服务商。

选择依据不是“哪边更强”，而是“这段能力是否构成差异化”。搜索与通用抓取不构成差异化，托管。

行业数据源接入、内部知识库权限、敏感字段脱敏构成差异化，自建或半自建。它们决定回答是否正确、是否越权。

多租户客服场景尤其如此。同一个搜索工具，A 租户能查公开网页，B 租户只能查授权知识库。这个边界服务商不知道，只有企业控制面知道。

05、架构：企业 Agent 控制面

控制面由十个部件组成，每个都要有明确归属。

模型网关：统一出口，做协议转换、多模型路由、密钥托管、失败降级。负责人是平台组。

租户隔离：请求携带租户标识，工具白名单、数据域、配额按租户配置。负责人是平台组与安全组。

数据授权：定义每个工具可访问的数据域，敏感字段在出网关前脱敏。负责人是数据治理组。

访问策略：按角色限制可用工具与可用模型，高危工具需二次审批。负责人是安全组。

上下文策略：规定检索条数、阅读深度、截断上限、引用保留方式。负责人是算法组。

审计 Trace：记录会话、工具调用、入参出参摘要、耗时、计费单元与最终回答。负责人是平台组。

预算与限流：按租户、按工具、按日设置额度，超限降级到无工具模式。负责人是平台组与财务。

评测：离线集加线上抽样，覆盖正确率与引用质量。负责人是算法组。

灰度与回滚：新模型或新工具策略按租户灰度，异常时一键回滚到旧配置。负责人是发布负责人。

跨角色泳道图https://developer.qcloudimg.com/http-save/yehe-9261324/c5bc884c75060169e7836f26ce253b16.png

泳道图要体现跨角色流转：用户提问，业务 Agent 发起调用，网关校验租户与预算，再决定走会话接口还是独立工具接口。

异常分支必须画出来：越权请求在网关被拒，工具超时降级为无工具回答，计费超限触发限流。

06、实战：两条调用路径怎么落地

第一条路径是会话内工具调用。业务 Agent 把用户问题发给网关，网关注入租户策略后调用 deepseek-flash 的 Responses 接口，开启联网搜索。

服务端完成搜索与上下文拼接，返回答案与工具事件。网关记录工具名、耗时、计费单元，再按租户策略做引用校验与脱敏。

第二条路径是独立工具调用。文件解析走 OCR 接口，语音客服走 ASR 与 TTS 接口，链接阅读走 Fetch 接口。

独立调用的好处是可控：每一步单独计费、单独限流、单独审计。适合对链路透明度要求高的场景。

工具调用时序图https://developer.qcloudimg.com/http-save/yehe-9261324/c18d6f39033c15003dc5e4ab1af325a5.png

时序图要覆盖两条链路：查询文章重名走会话接口加搜索工具，上传 ZIP 走文件输入或 OCR 独立接口。

两条链路共用网关的校验、预算与审计，区别在于工具调用发生在服务端还是由应用显式发起。

代码层面，网关的核心是最小校验与统一记账。下面是一段示意，说明请求进入网关后先做什么。

java

public GatewayResult handle(GatewayRequest req) {

TenantPolicy p = policyRepo.load(req.tenantId());

if (!p.allowedTools().containsAll(req.tools())) {

return GatewayResult.reject("TOOL_NOT_ALLOWED");

}

if (budget.exceeded(req.tenantId(), req.tools())) {

return GatewayResult.degrade("BUDGET_LIMIT");

}

return client.call(req.withPolicy(p));

}

这段代码不替代业务解释。它只说明三件事：租户策略先于模型调用，预算检查先于工具执行，拒绝与降级是两条不同路径。

07、验收：指标与检查清单

指标要可测。正确率用离线评测集加线上抽样，按场景分桶。引用质量看引用是否可追溯、是否支撑结论。

P95 延迟按接口分：会话接口含工具调用，独立工具接口单独统计。费用按租户、按工具、按日拆分，区分 Token 与工具调用费。

越权率是红线指标，统计被网关拒绝的请求占比与漏放数量。漏放必须为零容忍。

检查清单要带负责人和验收条件。

网关唯一出口：平台组负责，验收条件是业务进程无模型密钥、无直连域名。

租户工具白名单：安全组负责，验收条件是跨租户越权用例全部被拒。

数据授权与脱敏：数据治理组负责，验收条件是敏感字段不出网关。

审计 Trace 完整：平台组负责，验收条件是任一会话可还原工具调用链与计费。

预算与限流：平台组与财务负责，验收条件是超限触发降级且可告警。

评测集与基线：算法组负责，验收条件是每次模型或策略变更都有对比报告。

灰度与回滚：发布负责人负责，验收条件是单租户灰度、五分钟内可回滚。

内容安全与 AI 标识：合规负责人负责，验收条件是对外回答通过审核并按要求标识。

08、洞见：平台的价值往控制面迁移

全家桶这类封装会持续发生。搜索、抓取、解析、语音这些标准能力，服务商做得比大多数企业好，也更便宜。

Agent 平台的竞争点因此从“我能接多少工具”转向“我能管住多少风险”。工具越多，控制面越重要。

多租户客服是典型例子。同一个模型、同一套工具，不同租户的数据域和预算完全不同。这个映射只能由企业自己维护。

研发治理也是。模型和工具策略的变更要有评测、灰度、回滚，否则一次配置改动就可能让某个租户的回答质量骤降。

所以“Agent 平台什么时候失业”这个问题问反了。该问的是：平台里哪些层还值得自建。

我的答案是：工具适配层逐步让给服务商，编排层保留差异化循环，控制面必须自建且要加强。

09、小结：把责任边界画清楚

DeepSeek 全家桶把标准工具链收进接口，降低了接入成本，也让工具调用计费更细。这是好事，前提是企业把控制面补齐。

自建与托管的分界，看这段能力是否构成差异化、是否涉及租户数据边界。通用能力托管，边界能力自建。

对外服务仍要承担内容安全审核、登记与 AI 标识义务。官方的基础安全校验是起点，不是终点。

平台不会因为工具被封装而失业。会失业的，是只会包一层工具、没有控制面的那类平台。

延伸阅读可从 DeepSeek 官方 API 文档的接口与工具章节入手，核对 deepseek_web_search 与 deepseek_read_url 的参数与计费说明。

独立工具接口的说明可在同一文档的 Search、Fetch、OCR、ASR、TTS 章节查阅，注意与会话接口区分。

MCP 官方文档的架构与安全章节，可用于对照企业工具接入的权限设计。

以上资料以官方当前版本为准，接口能力与计费可能调整，落地前请复核。

先把“Agent 平台”拆开看。它通常包含四层：模型接入、工具适配、编排运行时、企业控制面。

模型接入层做协议转换、密钥管理、多模型路由。工具适配层把搜索、抓取、OCR 包成统一函数。编排层管多步循环与状态。控制面管权限、审计、预算、评测。

全家桶直接吃掉的是工具适配层的大部分，以及编排层里“搜索加阅读”这类标准循环。这部分自建成本高、差异化低，交给服务商合理。

控制面反而更值钱了。因为工具越强，一次调用能触达的外部数据越多，越权和数据外泄的后果越重。

需要区分两类接口。会话接口是 Messages、Responses、Chat Completions，工具调用在会话内完成。独立接口是 Search、Fetch、OCR、ASR、TTS，按能力单独计费。

也要区分官方功能与企业治理。官方提供的是基础安全校验，不等于企业内容安全审核、登记与 AI 标识义务的履行。对外服务的主体责任仍在企业侧。

# 03、原理：服务端拼接改变了什么

传统自建链路里，模型只负责决策，搜索、抓取、解析、截断、拼上下文都由应用完成。每一步都可观测，也都可能出错。

全家桶把这段循环移到服务端。好处是链路短、适配少、标准场景上线快。代价是中间过程对调用方不再完全透明。

透明度的损失体现在三处。第一，检索了什么、读到了什么，调用方只能从返回结果和工具事件里推断。第二，上下文如何截断与排序，由服务端策略决定。第三，工具调用单独计费，成本结构比纯 Token 更复杂。

这不构成反对理由，而是设计约束。控制面必须补上可观测性：记录工具名、入参摘要、返回摘要、耗时与计费单元。

部署边界要画清楚。左侧是用户与业务 Agent，中间是企业模型网关与控制面，右侧是 DeepSeek 会话接口与独立工具接口。

网关是唯一出口。业务服务不直连模型，密钥不下发到业务进程。这样租户隔离、预算和审计才有落点。

# 04、取舍：自建还是托管

自建工具链的优点是可控：抓取策略、解析规则、缓存、脱敏都能自己定。代价是维护成本高，站点改版、反爬变化、文件格式兼容都要人跟。

托管工具链的优点是上线快、标准场景覆盖好、少写适配代码。代价是策略黑盒、计费叠加、异常时排查依赖服务商。

选择依据不是“哪边更强”，而是“这段能力是否构成差异化”。搜索与通用抓取不构成差异化，托管。

行业数据源接入、内部知识库权限、敏感字段脱敏构成差异化，自建或半自建。它们决定回答是否正确、是否越权。

多租户客服场景尤其如此。同一个搜索工具，A 租户能查公开网页，B 租户只能查授权知识库。这个边界服务商不知道，只有企业控制面知道。

# 05、架构：企业 Agent 控制面

控制面由十个部件组成，每个都要有明确归属。

模型网关：统一出口，做协议转换、多模型路由、密钥托管、失败降级。负责人是平台组。

租户隔离：请求携带租户标识，工具白名单、数据域、配额按租户配置。负责人是平台组与安全组。

数据授权：定义每个工具可访问的数据域，敏感字段在出网关前脱敏。负责人是数据治理组。

访问策略：按角色限制可用工具与可用模型，高危工具需二次审批。负责人是安全组。

上下文策略：规定检索条数、阅读深度、截断上限、引用保留方式。负责人是算法组。

审计 Trace：记录会话、工具调用、入参出参摘要、耗时、计费单元与最终回答。负责人是平台组。

预算与限流：按租户、按工具、按日设置额度，超限降级到无工具模式。负责人是平台组与财务。

评测：离线集加线上抽样，覆盖正确率与引用质量。负责人是算法组。

灰度与回滚：新模型或新工具策略按租户灰度，异常时一键回滚到旧配置。负责人是发布负责人。

异常分支必须画出来：越权请求在网关被拒，工具超时降级为无工具回答，计费超限触发限流。

# 06、实战：两条调用路径怎么落地

第一条路径是会话内工具调用。业务 Agent 把用户问题发给网关，网关注入租户策略后调用 deepseek-flash 的 Responses 接口，开启联网搜索。

服务端完成搜索与上下文拼接，返回答案与工具事件。网关记录工具名、耗时、计费单元，再按租户策略做引用校验与脱敏。

第二条路径是独立工具调用。文件解析走 OCR 接口，语音客服走 ASR 与 TTS 接口，链接阅读走 Fetch 接口。

独立调用的好处是可控：每一步单独计费、单独限流、单独审计。适合对链路透明度要求高的场景。

时序图要覆盖两条链路：查询文章重名走会话接口加搜索工具，上传 ZIP 走文件输入或 OCR 独立接口。

两条链路共用网关的校验、预算与审计，区别在于工具调用发生在服务端还是由应用显式发起。

代码层面，网关的核心是最小校验与统一记账。下面是一段示意，说明请求进入网关后先做什么。

代码语言： Java

AI代码解释
public GatewayResult handle(GatewayRequest req) {
    TenantPolicy p = policyRepo.load(req.tenantId());
    if (!p.allowedTools().containsAll(req.tools())) {
        return GatewayResult.reject("TOOL_NOT_ALLOWED");
    }
    if (budget.exceeded(req.tenantId(), req.tools())) {
        return GatewayResult.degrade("BUDGET_LIMIT");
    }
    return client.call(req.withPolicy(p));
}

这段代码不替代业务解释。它只说明三件事：租户策略先于模型调用，预算检查先于工具执行，拒绝与降级是两条不同路径。

# 07、验收：指标与检查清单

指标要可测。正确率用离线评测集加线上抽样，按场景分桶。引用质量看引用是否可追溯、是否支撑结论。

P95 延迟按接口分：会话接口含工具调用，独立工具接口单独统计。费用按租户、按工具、按日拆分，区分 Token 与工具调用费。

越权率是红线指标，统计被网关拒绝的请求占比与漏放数量。漏放必须为零容忍。

检查清单要带负责人和验收条件。

网关唯一出口：平台组负责，验收条件是业务进程无模型密钥、无直连域名。

租户工具白名单：安全组负责，验收条件是跨租户越权用例全部被拒。

数据授权与脱敏：数据治理组负责，验收条件是敏感字段不出网关。

审计 Trace 完整：平台组负责，验收条件是任一会话可还原工具调用链与计费。

预算与限流：平台组与财务负责，验收条件是超限触发降级且可告警。

评测集与基线：算法组负责，验收条件是每次模型或策略变更都有对比报告。

灰度与回滚：发布负责人负责，验收条

# 阿里通义千问Qwen4-Max正式版发布

IT之家 11 月 16 日消息，阿里通义千问团队今日宣布推出新一代旗舰模型 Qwen4-Max，采用全新的 MoE（混合专家）架构，主干参数规模达到 2.4 万亿，原生支持视觉理解，并提供 100 万 Token 上下文窗口。

与此前 11 月 11 日先行开放的限时预览版不同，此次发布标志着 Qwen4-Max 作为正式版本接入千问 AI 平台，开发者可通过 Token Plan 或 API 调用。

Qwen4-Max 采用稀疏 MoE 架构，围绕 Attention、Residual 和 Embedding 三个层面做了系统性调整。每四层中三层使用 Gated DeltaNet 将历史信息压缩为固定状态，剩余一层以 Qwen Sparse Attention 按 block 粒度选择相关上下文，以降低长序列的注意力计算开销；Gated Residual 将残差流扩展为四条并行分支，增强跨层信息传递；N-gram Embedding 则在第二层以查表方式提供局部 token 模式表示，以较低额外算力扩展模型容量。

官方称，新模型在提升复杂工作任务处理能力的同时，能够减少 Token 消耗并降低任务成本。

根据 Qwen 官方博客介绍，Qwen4-Max 面向办公生产力、创意创作、软件开发和科学研究等场景，重点提升专业工具使用能力、长周期任务执行能力以及最终交付质量。模型能够处理 3D 建模、游戏开发、工业制造、金融、法律、医疗和前沿科学研究等任务。

效率是此次升级的显性指标。Qwen4-Max 在 Work360 行业基准上取得 52.69 分，前代 Qwen3.8-Max 为 47.74 分。

在同等性能下，Xhigh 和 High 两档推理强度的 token 消耗分别比前代减少约 24% 和 35%；Terminal-Bench 4.0 上的 token 消耗降幅则达到约 48% 和 49%。API 定价同步下调，尤其大幅降低了缓存命中价格，Work360 评测中单个任务的平均费用从 26.58 元降至 11.16 元，降幅 58%。

为了评估模型在真实工作场景中的表现，Qwen 团队还开发了 Work360 评测框架，用于模拟和分类复杂的专业工作任务。IT之家注意到，该框架覆盖 26 个一级领域、182 个二级子领域和 721 个三级专业方向，涉及多种行业和职业工作流程。

模型能力向长程任务执行倾斜。Qwen4-Max 支持百万 token 上下文窗口和原生视觉输入，在智能体场景中引入 Live Delivery 机制：先交付可用首版，再根据用户反馈逐版扩展内容与质量，同步开源了 Qwen-Live-Delivery-Plugin 插件。

官方展示的案例覆盖 Blender 三维建模、Unity 与 Unreal 引擎游戏开发、汽车产线规划与零件加工编程，以及金融投研、法律尽调和危重症临床辅助等专业场景。在汽车零件加工案例中，单个工件编程的人工投入从约 475 分钟降至 24 分钟。

Qwen4-Max 是 Qwen4 系列的首款模型。官方表示，系列中的小尺寸模型将陆续开源，沿袭同源技术路线，面向小模型更擅长的场景做取舍。

目前，Qwen4-Max API 已在 QwenCloud 上线，开发者可以通过 API 接入。此外，用户还可以通过 Qwen Studio、QwenWork 和 Qoder 体验新模型。

Verified details regarding GLM-4.7 specifications, capabilities, and API integration.

## 

### What is GLM-4.7 and what are its core capabilities?

GLM-4.7 is a text-based foundation model developed by Z.ai for programming tasks, systematic reasoning, and tool integration. Confirmed in provider documentation on 15 November 2026, the model features a 200K token context window, a provider-side maximum output limit of 128K tokens, and native support for optional thinking modes, token streaming, function calling, structured JSON output, and context caching. It accepts and generates text only.

## 

### Is GLM-4.7 available to use on glm5.app?

GLM-4.7 is integrated across our chat workspace and public API layer, supporting advanced programming, deliberate reasoning, and tool execution. As a dedicated text-only model with up to 200K context, it operates without multimodal support. Users can select GLM 4.7 in the chat workspace or connect via our API endpoint.

### How does GLM-4.7 differ from Claude Opus 4.7?

GLM-4.7 and Claude Opus 4.7 are completely separate models developed by different entities. GLM-4.7 belongs to Z.ai’s General Language Model lineage, whereas Claude Opus 4.7 is developed by Anthropic. ##

Z.ai documents GLM-4.7, Flash, and FlashX as three distinct model offerings with separate identifiers and operational targets. Benchmark results, latency behavior, or context handling observed in Flash or FlashX must not be attributed to the base GLM-4.7 model. Always verify your specific endpoint catalog and model parameter string before initiating calls.

No. The official Z.ai specifications confirmed on 15 November 2026 define GLM-4.7 strictly as a text input and text output architecture. While the model can analyze, generate, or refactor software code that interacts with graphics libraries and cameras, it does not possess native multimodal vision or video generation capabilities.

## 

### What is the role of optional reasoning in GLM-4.7?

GLM-4.7 supports an optional reasoning or thinking mode that executes multi-step deduction before producing a finalized response. This mode is particularly valuable for diagnosing subtle concurrency bugs, planning complex refactors, and validating schema constraints. For low-latency or repetitive utility tasks, the reasoning mode can be bypassed to maintain direct execution speed.

## 

### How can I connect to GLM-4.7 via the API?

Requests are submitted to https://glm5.app/api/v1/chat/completions using standard OpenAI-compatible payloads with the model set to glm-4.7 and authenticated via your GLM5_API_KEY. Detailed schema definitions and API parameters are available at /api/docs. Direct upstream integration is documented by Z.ai.

## Origin and Architecture

The model family traces its foundation to the General Language Model research lineage established by Zhipu AI (Z.ai). Selecting an effective model requires distinguishing between the overarching research family and specific hosted releases.

01

### The General Language Model lineage

It is a family of language models developed by Zhipu AI / Z.ai. Because the name describes a multi-generational family, always refer to an exact version identifier when evaluating capability.

02

### Natural language and code generation

Modern releases process unstructured user context to perform complex programming, contextual rewriting, and structured information extraction based on prompt instructions and supplied boundaries.

### Code review and bug isolation

Provide explicit reference notes and define target length, audience, and structure. Request an outline first, and instruct the model not to introduce assertions outside your source text.

01

### Upstream specifications vs. hosted availability

Z.ai defines base model architecture, weight licensing, and theoretical context windows. glm5.app establishes its own endpoint configurations, concurrency limits, and platform-level feature access.

03

### Mandatory human and automated verification

Language models can produce plausible but inaccurate statements or flawed code. Keep human verification and automated regression suites active in workflows where errors carry real-world consequences.

"Analyze this function: [code]. Given input [input], the actual output is [actual] instead of [expected]. Identify the failure mechanism, provide a minimal fix, and write a test case to prevent regression."

## 

### What does the GLM acronym signify in artificial intelligence?

The acronym stands for General Language Model, an AI research lineage and model family created by Zhipu AI (also operating as Z.ai). In AI discussions, it denotes their proprietary and open generative models for text, code, and multimodal tasks.

## 

### How does GLM relate to ChatGLM?

ChatGLM represents earlier dialogue-tuned models within the broader research lineage. The overarching family name encompasses later iterations, such as versions 4 and 5. Each major version introduces distinct architecture, licensing, and performance capabilities.

## 

### Is glm5.app an official Zhipu AI website?

No. glm5.app is a hosted chat and API service. Zhipu AI / Z.ai publishes the upstream models and research. Account plans, registry availability, and infrastructure limits on this site belong entirely to glm5.app.

The web composer defaults explicitly to version 5.3 Flash to provide interactive responses. If your task requires the specialized reasoning of version 5.3 or backward compatibility with versions 5.2, 4.7, or 4.6, select it manually in the composer.

You can connect via HTTP POST requests to https://glm5.app/api/v1/chat/completions using standard Bearer token authentication. Retrieve and configure API keys at /settings/apikeys, and check supported model IDs in the API documentation before deployment.

### Does GLM refer to generalized linear models or graphics math?

# China’s Moonshot AI puts Kimi models into race for science discoveries

Company explores applications that demand more advanced reasoning, pushing into biology, chemistry and pharmaceutical research

2-MIN READ2-MIN

0

Listen

Chinese artificial intelligence start-up Moonshot AI, the developer of the Kimi models, is setting its sights on scientific discovery, joining US rivals in the race to turn AI into a research engine.

The Beijing-based company is increasingly exploring applications that demand more advanced AI reasoning capabilities, pushing into the realms of biology, chemistry and pharmaceutical research.

“The real excitement is … science,” said Giacomo Ficari, Moonshot’s director of international, during a keynote address at the Web Summit technology conference in Lisbon late last week. “While finance and legal are [at] the same level of intelligence [as] coding, science is actually bringing the level of intelligence even higher.”

Ficari said coding, which had driven much of the recent demand for advanced AI models, was approaching saturation in terms of technological progress, prompting Moonshot to explore applications in domains like scientific and pharmaceutical research.

“You see OpenAI focusing a lot on mathematics,” he said. “We are focusing a lot on biology and chemistry. Think about what we can do with pharma and all the technological advancement.”

The company has begun putting its ambitions into practice. On Thursday, DP Technology – a Beijing-based AI-for-science start-up – announced a collaboration with Moonshot to integrate the Kimi K3.1 Pro model into its research agent for biomedical applications.

DP Technology said that in an internal evaluation of AI models for biological research tasks, Kimi K3.1 Pro paired with its coding tool achieved the highest score, relative to other undisclosed model combinations.

In one demonstration, BioMaster, DP Technology’s research agent, and Kimi analysed gene-expression data from 3,696 mouse pancreatic cells, identifying 100 candidate genes for further investigation in about 90 minutes, compared with an estimated four hours of human work.

While the results highlight how advanced models can automate time-consuming data analysis, they stop short of showing an ability to make autonomous scientific breakthroughs.

That distinction was underscored earlier this month in a paper co-authored by Moonshot founder Yang Zhilin and Turing Award-winning computer scientist Andrew Yao, which examined whether leading AI models could contribute to original mathematical research.

The study introduced a benchmark comprising 100 tasks spanning mathematical theorem proving, algorithm development and attempts to solve long-standing unsolved problems in theoretical computer science.

The researchers found that while frontier models could produce verifiable results and assist with complex research tasks, none could independently solve the benchmark’s open mathematical conjectures – highlighting both the promise and current limits of AI in autonomous research.

Moonshot did not immediately respond to a request for comment on Monday.

The company’s push comes amid rival claims of scientific milestones from US peers.

Last month, OpenAI claimed in a blog post that its models had made three new discoveries across mathematics, computer science and physics, generating proofs for long-standing problems. However, its results drew pushback from the scientific community, particularly mathematicians.

In September, Anthropic said its researchers had used its Claude model to discover a new enzyme system.

Still, industry insiders remain cautious about AI’s near-term impact on pharmaceutical research and development.

A survey of 50 US-based pharmaceutical R&D executives by Citi in June found that only 24 per cent expected AI to significantly improve the probability of drug success, even though 72 per cent said their firms were “scaling” or had “fully scaled” the technology across research operations.

Advertisement

Chong Ming is a tech reporter covering China's AI ecosystem, the latest developments in AI, and US-China competition. Previously, he was an AI reporter for Business Insider's Singapore bureau, and began his journalism career at CNA Digital in Singapore. He is a fellow at the Tarbell Center for AI Journalism.

Kimi.content:
# Kimi is valued at 50 billion U.S. dollars. Why is Moonshot AI in a hurry to dismantle its overseas structure?

厚雪商业2026-11-16 08:32

For Yang Zhilin, the next exam is no longer just a technical test.

On November 13, according to The Wall Street Journal, Moonshot AI, the developer of Kimi, is adjusting its corporate structure ahead of the listing: it plans to terminate the operation of its Cayman holding company, repurchase the relevant shares held by early investors, and then arrange for investors to reinvest the funds into the main operating entity within mainland China.

This adjustment is regarded by the outside world as a key step for Moonshot AI to prepare for its Hong Kong stock IPO.

Previously, the market has spread the news that Moonshot AI plans to list in Hong Kong. Bloomberg reported that the company's latest round of financing values it at about 500 billion US dollars, and it is considering landing on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in the first quarter of 2027, with the maximum fundraising scale possibly reaching 50 billion US dollars.

If this plan is implemented, Moonshot AI will become an important representative of Chinese AI startups that march into the public market.

However, what deserves more attention than the listing time and fundraising scale is the capital structure it is adjusting.

Why does an AI company that started with US dollar funds choose to dismantle the overseas structure that once helped it raise financing when preparing for listing?

## 01

## Starting with US dollar capital, why return to the domestic market?

In 2023, Yang Zhilin founded Moonshot AI and launched Kimi. Relying on its long-text processing capability, the company quickly gained market attention. Institutions including HSG, ZhenFund, Alibaba, Tencent, and Meituan have successively participated in its investment.

For a large model startup, financing capability is of vital importance.

Training models requires massive computing power, R&D requires continuous investment, and the talent cost is far higher than that of ordinary Internet startups. Before the product generates stable revenue, capital almost determines whether an enterprise can stay in the game sustainably.

US dollar funds and overseas holding structures used to be important ways for Chinese tech startups to connect with international capital.

A typical red-chip structure means that an enterprise sets up a holding company overseas, and then controls the domestic operating entity through equity or agreement arrangements. Overseas investors hold shares of the overseas company, which in turn controls the domestic business.

This structure facilitates the introduction of US dollar funds and reserves space for future overseas listing.

However, when an enterprise develops to a certain scale, the original structure may no longer be applicable.

Moonshot AI's core R&D, team and main business are all located within mainland China. As the company prepares for listing, what regulators and the capital market need to clarify is not only the list of shareholders, but also who actually controls the company, which entity owns the core assets, and how the rights and interests of overseas shareholders correspond to the domestic business.

For an enterprise that masters large model technology and involves a large amount of data and computing power resources, these issues are particularly critical.

Therefore, this adjustment by Moonshot AI is not as simple as just deregistering a Cayman company, but to re-sort out the relationship between domestic and overseas entities, so as to make the equity structure, core business and future listing entity clearer.

This does not mean that it will completely cut off ties with international capital.

According to The Wall Street Journal's report, after the structural adjustment, investors may still retain the option of conducting US dollar transactions through entities outside mainland China. In other words, what Moonshot AI hopes to adjust is the path for capital to enter the company, rather than simply closing the overseas investment channel.

Behind this is a new problem that Chinese AI startups are facing: in the early stage, they need international capital to help them grow rapidly, and after entering the listing stage, they must make the capital structure adapt to the regulatory requirements and listing rules of the place where the business is located.

## 02

## Dismantling the overseas structure, the most difficult part is handling the old shareholders

The really complicated part of structural adjustment does not lie in deregistering an overseas company, but in how to handle the investors who have already entered the company.

Moonshot AI has gone through multiple rounds of financing. Different investors entered the company at different times, with different investment currencies, different shareholding entities and different future exit arrangements.

When the company decides to adjust its holding structure, the original rights and interests need to be re-sorted out.

According to the plan reported by the media, Moonshot AI will repurchase the relevant shares held by early investors, and then the investors will reinvest the funds into the domestic operating entity. This means that investors who originally held rights and interests through the overseas holding company need to re-establish an investment relationship with the domestic entity.

There are at least three issues involved here.

The first is how to connect the valuations.

When early investors entered the company, the company's valuation is completely different from that of today. The latest financing valuation spread in the market now is about 500 billion US dollars. When reinvesting, the shareholding ratio, investment cost and future income expectation of old shareholders may all be affected.

The second is the arrangement of funds and taxation.

Overseas share repurchase, capital transfer, and domestic reinvestment involve the legal and tax rules of different jurisdictions. How to handle US dollar funds, how to confirm the original rights and interests, and how to register shareholding after reinvestment all need to be solved one by one.

The last is the future exit channels.

For US dollar funds, investing in a Chinese AI company is not only optimistic about the technology, but also needs to consider how to exit in the future. If the overseas structure changes, investors must reconfirm how their rights and interests are protected, and whether there is still the possibility of US dollar transaction and exit in the future.

Therefore, this adjustment tests not only the company's execution capability, but also the coordination capability between the founding team and early investors.

For Moonshot AI, sorting out the equity relationship before listing can reduce the future audit and governance costs; for investors, the key is whether the original rights and interests can be properly inherited, and whether the future income and exit path are clear.

The $500 billion valuation makes this matter more sensitive.

It should be noted that the $500 billion is the financing valuation reported by the media, which is not equal to the final IPO pricing; $50 billion is only the upper limit of the fundraising scale spread in the market, not the determined issuance plan.

But these two figures at least indicate that Moonshot AI is moving from the financing logic of the primary market to the governance logic of the public market.

In the past, investors were willing to pay a premium for technological potential and growth expectations; after entering the listing stage, the market will also ask about the equity structure, financial quality, corporate governance and sustainable profitability.

Capital can help the company expand rapidly, but cannot replace the company to build a stable operation system.

## 03

## After the $500 billion valuation, the market will see how it makes money

If we only look at the valuation, Moonshot AI's story is already dazzling enough.

Kimi quickly opened up the market relying on its model capability, and the company is continuously launching new models and products. Media reports said that Moonshot AI once disclosed to investors that its annual recurring revenue (ARR) is expected to reach 2 billion US dollars by the end of 2026, doubling from 1 billion US dollars in August.

However, ARR is an annualized indicator calculated based on the current revenue operation, which is not equal to the confirmed full-year operating revenue, let alone that the company has achieved profitability.

This is exactly the problem that Moonshot AI must face after listing: how to convert model capability into sustainable and scalable revenue?

The commercialization of large model companies mainly has several paths.

For individual users, revenue can be obtained through subscription, but user scale is not equal to paying user scale. There are obvious differences among free users, paying users and high-frequency users. The stronger the model capability, the more willing users may be to pay, but the reasoning cost may also rise accordingly.

If revenue growth cannot catch up with the growth of reasoning cost, scale expansion may not necessarily bring profit improvement.

# 月之暗面拆除VIE架構 衝刺港股IPO 估值已升至500億美元

鉅亨網新聞中心

中國人工智慧新創公司「月之暗面」(Moonshot AI)傳出上市進程重大突破。根據《華爾街日報》報導，月之暗面正調整上市前股權架構，計畫終止開曼群島控股公司運作，回購早期美元投資者持股並安排其再投資至中國境內營運實體，完成拆除離岸VIE(可變利益實體)架構。

報導指出，此舉旨在符合港交所上市審查標準，目標於2027年第一季掛牌上市，集資規模最高可達50億美元。

###### 十個月估值飆升數倍

月之暗面由清華大學畢業、曾任職於Google Brain與Meta的楊植麟於2023年4月創立，憑藉大語言模型Kimi的高長文本處理能力迅速崛起。

月之暗面吸引阿里巴巴、騰訊、紅杉中國、真格基金及美團龍珠等機構參投。公司估值自2025年底的43億美元，歷經多輪融資後，於2026年10月初飆升至500億美元，十個月內翻升逾十倍。

目前工商登記顯示楊植麟在境內實體持股約51.83%。離岸控股架構初期利於引進美元基金，但在邁入上市階段時，監理機關與市場需明確釐清實際控制權與核心資產歸屬。此次股權重組雖回購開曼股份，但同時保留投資者未來透過海外實體進行美元交易的彈性。

###### 海外市場與API服務帶動ARR暴增

商業化推進方面，月之暗面經歷了從C端流量競爭向B端開發者生態的轉型。據QuestMobile數據，2024年投入約1億美元行銷費用後，Kimi月活躍用戶一度突破2,000萬人，隨後因同業競爭加劇，2025年底月活回落至約900萬人。

面對行銷成本上升與國內競爭，楊植麟團隊將資源傾斜至基礎模型開發與海外開發者生態。研調機構Sacra與《上海證券報》數據顯示，2026年6月Kimi的API(應用程式介面)調用收入已占整體企業端營收七成以上，且自2026年2月起海外收入首次超越國內市場。

在API與國際化拉動下，月之暗面的年化經常性收入(ARR)由2025年底的1,500萬美元，於2026年8月躍升至10億美元，並規劃於年底衝刺20億美元目標。

###### 算力成本壓力

儘管營收大幅增長，月之暗面仍須面對高昂的算力成本與公開市場檢視。雖然Kimi K3及K3.1 Pro模型在程式設計榜單上取得優異成績，但單題推理成本相較於競爭對手DeepSeek仍高出數倍，計算資源採購與推理毛利率將是影響損益平衡的關鍵。

此外，港股同業表現也提供參照基準。2026年1月上市的智譜與MiniMax在經歷初期股價大漲後均出現顯著回檔，外資券商摩根大通與匯豐證券先後下調目標價並延後損益平衡預期。

# xAI (Grok)

Thexai provider supports xAI's Grok models through an API interface compatible with OpenAI's format, including text, vision, image generation, video generation, and voice workflows.

## Setup

To use xAI's API, set theXAI_API_KEY environment variable or specify via apiKey in the configuration file.
export XAI_API_KEY=your_api_key_here

When xAI is the selected fallback provider family, Promptfoo can use xAI defaults for grading, suggestions, synthesis, and web search. These automatic defaults currently usegrok-4.3 on the global endpoint; select grok-4.7, grok-4.6, or grok-4.5 explicitly where they are available. xAI does not currently expose a public embeddings or moderation API, so those defaults fall back to OpenAI when xAI is selected. Explicit provider IDs in your config still take precedence.

## Supported Models

The xAI provider includes support for the following model formats. xAI recommendsgrok-4.7 for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work; consult the public model catalog for current availability.

Legacy xAI model aliases

xAI periodically retires older model slugs and keeps them working through redirects. As of the May 15, 2026 (12:00 PM PT) retirement, requests to thegrok-4-1-fast, grok-4-fast, grok-4-0709, and grok-3 families redirect to grok-4.3 and use Grok 4.3 pricing. Requests to grok-code-fast-1 route to grok-build-0.1, while grok-imagine-image-pro routes to grok-imagine-image-quality. For new configs, use a current canonical model ID directly.

Regional model availability

xAI documents Grok 4.7 on its global and US regional endpoints, and announced Grok 4.5 availability in the EU API Console. Check your account before depending on Grok 4.7 in another region;grok-4.3 remains Promptfoo's automatic fallback.

### Grok 4.7 Models

- xai:grok-4.7 - Chat Completions; 500K context, text and image input, text output
- xai:responses:grok-4.7 - Responses API, including server-side tools and encrypted reasoning

Use the exactgrok-4.7 model ID. Grok 4.7 Fast is available in Cursor and Grok Build, but not on the public xAI API.

### Grok 4.6 Models

xAI does not publish any aliases for this model, so target the exactgrok-4.6 id. There is no grok-4.6-latest.

### Grok 4.5 Models

### Grok 4.1 Fast Models

### Grok-2 and previous Models

Promptfoo recognizes oldergrok-2, grok-beta, and vision IDs for existing configs, but they are not in xAI's current public catalog. Use a current model for new configs and verify legacy availability in the xAI Console.

## Configuration

The provider uses OpenAI-compatible configuration options plus Grok-specific options, subject to the model restrictions below. Example usage:

When xAI returnsusage.cost_in_usd_ticks, Promptfoo uses that exact billed amount, including cache discounts and request-level pricing adjustments. If ticks are unavailable, Promptfoo falls back to the model's catalog rates and applies the documented 2x premium when the response confirms service_tier: priority. Custom pricing can be set with cost, inputCost, outputCost, and cacheReadCost (all per-token rates); explicit overrides take precedence over reported ticks and are used as final rates without an additional priority multiplier.
providers:
  - id: xai:grok-4.7
    config:
      temperature: 0.7
      reasoning_effort: 'xhigh' # low, medium, high (default), or xhigh
      apiKey: your_api_key_here # Alternative to XAI_API_KEY

Bothxai:<model> Chat Completions and xai:responses:<model> support xAI
Priority Processing.
Set service_tier to priority for higher scheduling priority or default for standard
processing; omitting it also uses the default tier. Other OpenAI-compatible tier names are not
valid on xAI.

### Reasoning Support

Multiple Grok models support reasoning capabilities:

Grok 4.7 and 4.6: Chat requests can setreasoning_effort to low, medium, high (the default), or xhigh. Responses API requests use reasoning.effort. Reasoning cannot be disabled; Promptfoo rejects none locally.

For Grok 4.7, cap output withmax_completion_tokens for Chat Completions or max_output_tokens for Responses. Chat also accepts max_tokens as an alias; use one spelling throughout an eval, including defaults and test cases. Within test options, set a request option directly or under passthrough, not both. Reasoning effort accepts a direct eval variable such as {{ effort }}; see the optional Grok 4.7 providers in the xAI chat example.

Grok 4.5: Chat requests can setreasoning_effort to low, medium, or high (the default); Promptfoo rejects other values locally. Responses API requests use reasoning.effort with the same values.

Grok 4.3: General-purpose reasoning model. Chat requests can setreasoning_effort to none, low, medium, or high; Responses API requests use reasoning.effort.

Grok Code Fast Models: Thegrok-code-fast-1 family are reasoning models optimized for agentic coding workflows. They support:

- Function calling and tool usage
- Web search viasearch_parameters
- Fast inference with built-in reasoning

### Grok 4.7 Specific Behavior

The xAI release notes list $2/M input, $0.50/M cached input, and $6/M output. At 200K or more input tokens, the rates are $4/M, $1/M, and $12/M respectively. When the API does not return a billed cost, Promptfoo uses these rates, including the 10% premium on xAI's US endpoint; explicit custom rates still take precedence. As with other Grok 4 reasoning models, Promptfoo stripspresence_penalty, frequency_penalty, and stop.

The Responses API returns encrypted reasoning even wheninclude is omitted. Promptfoo keeps it in response.raw.output; pass these items back unchanged when managing conversation history yourself.

### Grok 4.5 Specific Behavior

Grok 4.5 is an earlier model for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work:

- 500K context window with text and image input
- Configurable reasoning:reasoning_effort accepts low, medium, or high (defaults to high); none is rejected
- Long-context pricing: requests with at least 200K input tokens use the higher catalog rate ($4/M input, $0.60/M cached input, and $12/M output instead of $2/M, $0.30/M, and $6/M); Promptfoo uses the exact billed ticks when xAI returns them
- Unsupported parameters:presence_penalty, frequency_penalty, and stop are rejected, and Promptfoo strips them automatically
- Ignored parameters: xAI silently ignoreslogprobs and top_logprobs on Grok 4.20 and newer models
- Server-side tools: usexai:responses:grok-4.5 for web search, X search, code execution, and MCP

providers:
  - id: xai:grok-4.5
    config:
      temperature: 0.7
      reasoning_effort: medium
      max_completion_tokens: 4096

### Grok 4.3 Specific Behavior

Grok 4.3 is a general-purpose alternative for text workflows:

- Responses API recommended: Usexai:responses:grok-4.3 for server-side tools, multi-turn state, and newer xAI capabilities
- Configurable reasoning: Setreasoning_effort to none, low, medium, or high
- Unsupported parameters: Same restrictions as other Grok 4-family reasoning models (presence_penalty, frequency_penalty, and stop)

providers:
  - id: xai:grok-4.3
    config:
      temperature: 0.7
      max_completion_tokens: 4096

Grok-3 Models: Promptfoo retains the legacy Grok 3 Mini reasoning-effort contract for backward compatibility. Use Grok 4.3 or Grok 4.7 for new configurations.

### Grok 4.1 Fast Specific Behavior

These retired IDs redirect to Grok 4.3 but retain their legacy request contract. Promptfoo stripsreasoning_effort, presence_penalty, freque

xAI.content:
# xAI Grok OAuth (SuperGrok / X Premium+)

Hermes Agent supports xAI Grok through a browser-based OAuth device-code login flow against accounts.x.ai, using either a SuperGrok subscription (grok.com) or an X Premium+ subscription (linked X account). NoXAI_API_KEY is required — log in once and Hermes automatically refreshes your session in the background. Comparing the two products? Hermes Agent vs Grok Bot covers model choice, platforms and pricing with sources.

When you sign in with an X account that has Premium+, xAI automatically links the subscription status to your xAI session, so the OAuth flow works the same as it does for direct SuperGrok subscribers.

The transport reuses thecodex_responses adapter (xAI exposes a Responses-style endpoint), so reasoning, tool-calling, streaming, and prompt caching work without any adapter changes.

The same OAuth bearer token is also reused by every direct-to-xAI surface in Hermes — TTS, image generation, video generation, and transcription — so a single login covers all four.

## Overview

Item | Value 
---|---
Provider ID | xai-oauth 
Display name | xAI Grok OAuth (SuperGrok / X Premium+) 
Auth type | Browser OAuth 2.0 device code 
Transport | xAI Responses API (codex_responses) 
Default model | grok-4.6 
Endpoint | https://api.x.ai/v1 
Auth server | https://accounts.x.ai 
Requires env var | No (XAI_API_KEY is not used for this provider) 
Subscription | SuperGrok or X Premium+ — see note below 

## Prerequisites

- Python 3.9+
- Hermes Agent installed
- An active SuperGrok subscription on your xAI account, or an X Premium+ subscription on the X account you sign in with (xAI links the subscription automatically)
- A browser available anywhere you can open the printed verification URL

:::warning xAI may restrict OAuth API access by tier xAI's backend enforces its own allowlist on the OAuth API surface and has been seen to reject standard SuperGrok subscribers withHTTP 403 (see issue #26847) even though the in-app subscription is active. If OAuth login succeeds in the browser but inference returns 403, set XAI_API_KEY and switch to the API-key path (provider: xai) — that surface is not subject to the same gating today.
:::

## Quick Start
# Launch the provider and model picker
hermes model
# → Select "xAI Grok OAuth (SuperGrok / X Premium+)" from the provider list
# → Hermes opens or prints an accounts.x.ai verification URL
# → Enter the displayed code if prompted, then approve access in the browser
# → Pick a model (grok-4.6 is at the top)
# → Start chatting

hermes

After the first login, credentials are stored under~/.hermes/auth.json and refreshed automatically before they expire.

## Logging In Manually

You can trigger a login without going through the model picker:
hermes auth add xai-oauth

### Remote / headless sessions

On servers, containers, browser-only consoles (Cloud Shell, Codespaces, EC2 Instance Connect), or SSH sessions where Hermes cannot open a browser locally, Hermes prints the xAI verification URL and user code. Open the URL in any browser on your laptop or in the cloud console, enter the code if prompted, and Hermes will keep polling until xAI approves the login. No SSH tunnel or local callback listener is required.
hermes auth add xai-oauth --no-browser
# Open the printed verification URL in your browser.

The same device-code flow applies when you sign in from the web dashboard or the desktop app: Hermes shows the verification URL and user code, then polls in the background until you approve access.

## How the Login Works

- Hermes requests a device code fromauth.x.ai.
- You open the verification URL, sign in, enter the displayed code if prompted, and approve access.
- Hermes polls xAI until approval, then saves tokens to~/.hermes/auth.json.
- From then on, Hermes refreshes the access token in the background — you stay signed in until youhermes auth logout xai-oauth or revoke access from your xAI account settings.

## Checking Login Status
hermes doctor

The◆ Auth Providers section will show the current state of every provider, including xai-oauth.

## Switching Models
hermes model
# → Select "xAI Grok OAuth (SuperGrok / X Premium+)"
# → Pick from the model list (grok-4.6 is pinned to the top)

Or set the model directly:
hermes config set model.default grok-4.6
hermes config set model.provider xai-oauth

## Configuration Reference

After login,~/.hermes/config.yaml will contain:
model:
  default: grok-4.6
  provider: xai-oauth
  base_url: https://api.x.ai/v1

### Provider aliases

All of the following resolve toxai-oauth:
hermes --provider xai-oauth        # canonical
hermes --provider grok-oauth       # alias
hermes --provider x-ai-oauth       # alias
hermes --provider xai-grok-oauth   # alias

## Direct-to-xAI Tools (TTS / Image / Video / Transcription / X Search)

Once you're logged in via OAuth, every direct-to-xAI tool reuses the same bearer token automatically — there is no separate setup unless you'd rather use an API key.

To pick a backend for each tool:
hermes tools
# → Text-to-Speech       → "xAI TTS"
# → Image Generation     → "xAI Grok Imagine (image)"
# → Video Generation     → "xAI Grok Imagine"
# → X (Twitter) Search   → "xAI Grok OAuth (SuperGrok / X Premium+)"

If OAuth tokens are already stored, the picker confirms it and skips the credential prompt. If neither OAuth norXAI_API_KEY is set, the picker offers a 3-choice menu: OAuth login, paste API key, or skip.

:::note Video generation is off by default Thevideo_gen toolset is disabled by default. Enable it in hermes tools → 🎬 Video Generation (press space) before the agent can call video_generate. Otherwise the agent may fall back to the bundled ComfyUI skill, which is also tagged for video generation.
:::

:::note X search auto-enables when xAI credentials are present Thex_search toolset auto-enables whenever xAI credentials (a SuperGrok / X Premium+ OAuth token or XAI_API_KEY) are configured. Disable explicitly via hermes tools → 🐦 X (Twitter) Search (press space) if you don't want this. The tool routes through xAI's built-in x_search Responses API — it works with either your SuperGrok / X Premium+ OAuth login or a paid XAI_API_KEY, and prefers OAuth when both are configured (uses your subscription quota instead of API spend). The tool schema is hidden from the model when no xAI credentials are configured, regardless of whether the toolset is enabled.
:::

### Models

Tool | Model | Notes 
---|---|---
Chat | grok-4.6 | Default; pinned to the top of the OAuth picker 
Chat | grok-build-0.1 | Coding-oriented Grok Build model

Chat | grok-4.20-0309-reasoning | Reasoning variant 
Chat | grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning | Non-reasoning variant 
Chat | grok-4.20-multi-agent-0309 | Multi-agent variant 
Image | grok-imagine-image | Default; ~5–10 s 
Image | grok-imagine-image-2.0 | Typography/layout-aware; strongest quality; ~10–20 s 
Image | grok-imagine-image-quality | Higher fidelity; ~10–20 s 
Video | grok-imagine-video | Text-to-video 
Video | grok-imagine-video-1.5-preview | Image-to-video; dated alias grok-imagine-video-1.5-2026-05-30 
TTS | (default voice) | xAI /v1/tts endpoint 

The chat catalog is derived live from the on-diskmodels.dev cache; new xAI releases appear automatically once that cache refreshes. grok-4.6 is always pinned to the top of the list.

## Environment Variables

Variable | Effect 
---|---
XAI_BASE_URL | Override the default https://api.x.ai/v1 endpoint (rarely needed). 

To select xAI as the active provider, setmodel.provider: xai-oauth in config.yaml (use hermes setup for the guided flow) or pass --provider xai-oauth for a single invocation.

## Troubleshooting

### Token expired — not re-logging in automatically

Hermes refreshes the token before each session and again reactively on a 401. If refresh fails withinvalid_grant (the refresh token was revoked, or the account was rotated), Hermes surfaces a typed re-auth message instead of crashing.

When the refresh failure is terminal (HTTP 4xx,invalid_grant, revoked grant, etc.), Hermes marks the refresh token as dead and quarantines it locally — subsequent calls skip the doomed refresh attempt instead of replaying the same 401 over and over. The agent surfaces a single "re-authentication required" message and stays out of the way until you log in again.

Fix: runhermes auth add xai-oauth again to start a fresh login. The quarantine clears on the next successful exchange.

### Authorization timed out

Device-code approval has a finite expiry window (xAI setsexpires_in on the device-code response, typically on the order of tens of minutes). If you do not approve the login in time, Hermes raises a timeout error.

Fix: re-runhermes auth add xai-oauth (or hermes model). The flow starts fresh.

### Logging in from a remote server

On SSH or container sessions Hermes prints the verification URL and user code instead of opening a browser. Open that URL in a browser on your laptop or in a cloud console — no SSH port forward is needed for xAI Grok OAuth.
hermes auth add xai-oauth --no-browser

For loopback-redirect providers (Spotify, MCP servers), see OAuth over SSH / Remote Hosts.

### HTTP 403 after a successful login (tier / entitlement)

OAuth completed in the browser, tokens are saved, but inference or token refresh returnsHTTP 403 with a message similar to "The caller does not have permission to execute the specified operation".

This is not a stale-token problem — re-runninghermes model won't change it. xAI's backend has been seen to restrict OAuth API access to specific SuperGrok tiers despite the in-app subscription being active (issue #26847).

Fix: setXAI_API_KEY and switch to the API-key path:
export XAI_API_KEY=xai-...
hermes config set model.provider xai

Or upgrade your subscription at x.ai/grok if the OAuth route is required.

# Grok

Grok是xAI推出的大模型AI助手，由埃隆・马斯克主导研发，名字源自科幻小说，寓意深度理解事物，2023年底首次对外发布。它最大的特色是深度对接X平台实时数据流，能够获取全网最新热点、动态资讯，区别于传统大模型受静态训练数据截止时间限制的短板，适合时效性强的资讯查询、热点分析。Grok持续迭代多个版本，支持文本对话、代码编写、图文生成、多模态解析，同时开放API接口，供开发者接入到应用、Agent项目当中。

在产品风格上，Grok设计思路偏向开放，相比很多AI工具限制更多问题，它的回答尺度更宽松，自带幽默的表达风格。部署渠道包含X平台内嵌入口、独立网页端、移动端App，订阅用户可以解锁高阶推理、长上下文、图像视频生成能力。它的算力依托专属超级计算集群，在数学推理、科研问题、复杂任务拆解上具备不错表现。

使用Grok也存在明显局限，实时信息会带来信息真假混杂的问题，需要人工甄别内容准确性；受海外网络环境限制，国内直接访问不便。在域名与建站行业，不少开发者会调用GrokAPI完成文案生成、代码调试、域名创意构思，是海外主流AI模型之一。

彭博社近期消息，马斯克旗下xAI及其AI产品Grok正卷入多起集体诉讼，原告指控平台安全护栏缺失，被不法分子利用，基于未成年人普通照片生成儿童性虐待类深度伪造图像，大量受害者在不知情的情况下被制作、传播色情化AI图片，案件持续发酵，给生成式AI安全治理带来标志性判例。

## LLMs

本章节收录主流大语言模型。先是 2024–2026 年最具影响力的旗舰、开源与国产模型，随后保留早期经典开源 LLM 供学习参考。

### 2024–2026 主流大模型

时间与版本截至 2026 年 8 月，模型迭代极快，请以官方渠道为准。

#### 国外闭源旗舰模型

模型 | 开发方 | 链接 | 中文简介（关键能力与发布时间） 
---|---|---|---
GPT-5.6（Luna / Terra / Sol） | OpenAI | openai.com | 2026 年 7 月 9 日发布的三档模型家族（由弱到强 Luna / Terra / Sol），面向企业工作、编码、科研与网络安全；Sol 为最强档，8 月 21 日起 API 降价 20%+。 
GPT-5 | OpenAI | openai.com | 2025 年 8 月发布，OpenAI 新一代旗舰，统一推理与对话（自动调度"思考"模式），取代 GPT-4o/o3 成为 ChatGPT 默认模型。 
o3 / o4-mini | OpenAI | openai.com | 2025 年 4 月发布的 o 系列推理模型，"先思考后回答"，o4-mini 主打高性价比快速推理。 
GPT-4.1 | OpenAI | openai.com | 2025 年 4 月发布，专精编码，100 万 token 长上下文，指令遵循强。 
Claude 5 家族（Fable 5 / Opus 5 / Sonnet 5） | Anthropic | platform.claude.com | 2026 年 6–7 月发布的第 5 代：Fable 5（6 月 9 日，Mythos 级旗舰，$10/$50 每百万 token）、Sonnet 5（6 月 30 日，$2/$10）、Opus 5（7 月 24 日，$5/$25，接近 Fable 5 智能但价格减半）；三者均 1M 上下文、128K 输出、自适应思考。 
Claude Opus 4.5 | Anthropic | anthropic.com | 2025 年 11 月发布，Anthropic 最强模型，编码与智能体能力顶尖。 
Claude Sonnet 4.5 | Anthropic | anthropic.com | 2025 年 9 月发布，平衡性能与成本，长程智能体任务表现优异。 
Claude 4（Opus 4 / Sonnet 4） | Anthropic | anthropic.com | 2025 年 5 月发布的第 4 代，Opus 4 号称"世界最佳编码模型"。 
Gemini 3.x（3.7 Flash / 3.5 Flash / 3.1 Pro） | Google DeepMind | changelog | 2026 年迭代：3.5 Flash（5 月 GA）、3.6 Flash（7 月）、3.7 Flash（8 月 13 日 GA，「最智能的编码 / Agent 主力模型」）；3.1 Pro 仍为预览。另有 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash 视频生成模型（8 月 GA）。 
Gemini 3 Pro | Google DeepMind | blog.google | 2025 年 11 月发布，Google 最强多模态旗舰，"推理优先"，含 Deep Think 模式。 
Gemini 2.5 Pro / Flash | Google DeepMind | developers.googleblog.com | "思考型"系列，Pro 主打高智能、Flash 主打低延迟低成本。 
Grok 4 | xAI | x.ai | 2025 年 7 月发布，256K 上下文，原生工具调用（代码、联网与 X 搜索）。 

#### 国外开源 / 开放权重模型

模型 | 开发方 | 链接 | 中文简介（关键能力与发布时间） 
---|---|---|---
Llama 4（Scout / Maverick） | Meta | ai.meta.com | 2025 年 4 月发布，原生多模态 MoE，Scout 上下文达 10M，Maverick 多模态超 GPT-4o。 
Llama 3.3 70B | Meta | llama.com | 2024 年 12 月发布，70B 性能对标 3.1 的 405B，推理成本大幅降低。

DeepSeekMath-V2 / OCR-2 | 深度求索 | Math-V2 ・OCR-2 | 专项模型：Math-V2（2025-11）自我可验证数学推理达 IMO 金牌；OCR-2（2026-01）Visual Causal Flow 文档理解。

GLM-4.6 / GLM-4.5 | 智谱 AI | HuggingFace | GLM-4.5（2025 年 7 月）355B/32B MoE，MIT 协议开源，面向智能体；GLM-4.6 进一步升级。 
Kimi K3 | 月之暗面 | GitHub ・HuggingFace | 2026 年 7 月开放权重（Kimi K3 License）：2.8T 参数原生多模态 Agent 模型，KDA + AttnRes 新架构，896 专家激活 16 个，1M 上下文，主打长程编码与端到端知识工作；配套开源 RL 环境平台 AgentENV。

ERNIE 4.5 / 文心一言 | 百度 | yiyan.baidu.com | 2025 年 3 月发布，MoE 架构最高 424B/47B；配套 ERNIE X1 深度推理模型。 
混元（Hunyuan / T1） | 腾讯 | hunyuan.tencent.com | 腾讯自研大模型家族，T1 推理模型开放使用，覆盖文本与多模态。 
豆包（Doubao） | 字节跳动 | doubao.com | 字节 C 端 AI 应用，月活领先，背后为字节自研大模型矩阵。 

#### 评测榜单与资源

资源 | 链接 | 中文简介 
---|---|---
LMArena（原 Chatbot Arena） | lmarena.ai | 众包匿名对战 + Elo 评分的权威 LLM 排行榜，业界最受认可的横向对比之一。

Models.dev | models.dev / GitHub | SST 团队开源的 AI 模型数据库，收录各家模型的上下文窗口、输出上限、价格、能力（推理/工具调用/结构化输出）与开闭源信息；提供免费 JSON API（models.dev/api.json），是 opencode 等开源项目的模型数据源，数据以 TOML 文件社区共建。

# The scale of open-weight models and European sovereign cloud partnerships

Mistral AI released Large 4, a 1000 billion parameter mixture-of-experts model, as part of its expanding open-weight ecosystem. The Paris-based company maintains European sovereignty through flexible data residency and significant investments from partners like Samsung Electronics.

Mistral AI released Large 4 in October 2026. This flagship model uses a mixture-of-experts architecture with 1000 billion parameters, where 52 billion remain active. The company also launched Le Chonk in September 2026, which utilizes 49 billion active parameters from a 1 billion parameter total to provide high performance within a compact architecture. Engineers trained Le Chonk using 3800 NVIDIA Grace-Blackwell GPUs. This model remains the only significant open-weight model not originating in China. Earlier in 2026, Mistral released Medium 3.5 in April, a 128 billion parameter model under a modified MIT license. In March 2026, Mistral Small 4 arrived with 119 billion parameters and 128 experts, providing both text and image inputs via an Apache-2.0 license. The company also released Voxtral Realtime in February 2026, which contains a 4 billion parameter model under an Apache-2.0 license specifically designed for real-time speech transcription tasks. In December 2025, Devstral 2 released as a 123 billion parameter dense model with a modified MIT license. Devstral Small 2 arrived in December 2025 with 24 billion parameters under Apache-2.0. A 24 billion parameter reasoning model, Magistral Small, arrived in June 2025.

Model Name | Release Date | Parameters (Total/Active) | License 
---|---|---|---
Large 4 | October 2026 | 1000B / 52B | Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight 
Medium 3.5 | April 2026 | 128B | Modified MIT 
Mistral Small 4 | March 2026 | 119B / 4 active per token | Apache-2.0 
Voxtral Realtime | February 2026 | 4B | Apache-2.0 
Devstral 2 | December 2025 | 123B | Modified MIT 

## Development and coding agents

Mistral provides Forge to allow users to customize models around specific data, use cases, and requirements. Developers use Studio to build, govern, and improve agents and applications. Vibe, formerly known as Le Chat, functions as an AI chat assistant and coding agent for individuals and enterprises. Vibe integrates with 100+ tools including Slack, GitHub, and Jira through connectors and full MCP compatibility. The product includes Vibe for work and Vibe for code. Developers launch coding tasks in Vibe using remote agents or via the CLI in VS Code, JetBrains, or Zed. Vibe writes, tests, and deploys code across a codebase to allow developers to focus on architecture and business logic. The tool also handles document processing, contract reviews, and candidate screening with human checkpoints. Users upload spreadsheets or connect databases to spot patterns, flag anomalies, and extract signals. Vibe generates PDFs, board decks, strategic briefs, RFP responses, PRDs, reports, and more from research and data. Users can get briefed on missed information across email, chat, calendar, and internal knowledge in a single run. Users search the web, internal documents, and connected tools to compile analysis. If you rely on legacy code, Vibe moves codebases to new languages and architectures. Vibe handles bulk-updates for libraries and resolves breaking changes. Vibe also scaffolds multi-file features using tests, types, and documentation. The coding agent produces unit and integration tests. It writes code that matches team patterns. Vibe uses context from GitHub, GitLab, Jira, project boards, and business context to inform every coding decision. The free version of Vibe limits access to the best models.

## European sovereignty and corporate investment

Mistral AI maintains its headquarters in Paris and employs over 1,000 people as of 2026. The company enables data residency in any cloud or datacenter. Users run models on-premises, in a private VPC, or on Mistral infrastructure. This flexibility keeps inference in-region and reserves dedicated GPU capacity. In September 2026, Samsung Electronics acquired a stake in Mistral in a transaction worth 3 billion Euro, which brought the company valuation to 21 billion Euro. This follows a 2 billion Euro investment in September 2025 that valued the firm at 12 billion Euro. ASML also holds a 11 percent stake after investing 1.5 billion USD. In June 2024, Mistral secured a 600 million Euro funding round. In May 2026, Mistral acquired the Linzer startup Emmi AI to expand its industrial AI and physics-based simulation capabilities. Mistral also expanded its platform in August 2026 to include GLM-5.2 from the Chinese company Z.ai. In Austria, the administration uses GovGPT, an application built on Mistral AI. Mistral’s founders, Arthur Mensch, Guillaume Lample, and Timothee Lacroix, met at the Ecole polytechnique. In February 2024, Microsoft announced that Mistral models would be available on the Microsoft Azure Cloud. Mistral’s founders previously worked at DeepMind and Meta Platforms. While Mistral provides high performance, can these European partnerships prevent total dependence on non-European hardware?

# Chinese AI labs restrict cyber training for open-weight releases

Moonshot says its new Kimi model is measurably worse at writing exploits, though testers found its refusals easy to bypass.

## Key takeaways

- Moonshot AI says withholding cyber training material cut its open-weight Kimi K3.1 Pro model's score on an internal exploit test from 91% to 81%.
- Copies of downloaded models cannot be recalled. Moonshot and Tencent say they restrict cyber training rather than relying only on refusals.
- FAR.AI bypassed Kimi's refusals. The retrieved tests do not establish whether its training restrictions survive further training or what they cost defensive security work.

Moonshot AI set an unreleased version of its newest model against pieces of vulnerable software, each sealed in a test environment, and gave it three tries to break into each one; it succeeded 91% of the time. The version the company went on to publish managed 81%. Moonshot, the Chinese AI company behind the Kimi chatbot, says the gap is deliberate. Before releasing Kimi K3.1 Pro as an open-weight model, meaning that anyone can download its trained parameters and run them on their own computers, it removed cyber-related material from part of the model's training data and filtered out the simulated hacking exercises used in a later stage of training to reward the model for success. Ordinary programming tasks stayed in.

Tencent, the Chinese internet giant, has drawn a similar line with Hy4, a model it launched on November 4 with a promise to publish its weights and safety documentation within days. Hy4's training, Tencent says, kept defensive security material, such as writing proof-of-concept code and fixing vulnerabilities, and left out material on offensive exploitation. Its in-house security labs, Xuanwu and Keen, tested the model on reverse-engineering cryptographic implementations, untangling deliberately obscured code and exploiting flaws, and Tencent reports no significant concerns about offensive capability in those areas. The announcement gives no numerical cyber results. Vector could not confirm a final Hy4 weight release by mid-November, though Tencent's separately named Hy4-preview weights are downloadable. Moonshot's are already on Hugging Face, an AI-model hosting platform, as a 1.6-terabyte download split into 96 files.

Downloadable weights let developers run and adapt models on their own infrastructure rather than buying every answer from the original lab; redistribution and commercial use depend on each model's license. Openness is also the difficulty, because a published model cannot be recalled. In its guidance on open-weight models, the Australian Signals Directorate, Australia's cyber-security and signals-intelligence agency, notes that people who download them can modify or remove their safeguards, and that the original developer can neither enforce nor update those protections. Organizations, it advises, should check where a model came from and how it has been altered, and not assume its release-day protections are still in place.

That leaves three kinds of protection, which differ in how well they survive a download. The first is a usage rule. Moonshot's license permits modification, fine-tuning and redistribution and requires users to obey the law, but contains no condition for screening out cyber misuse. Its main commercial clause requires a separate agreement with Moonshot when a licensee or its affiliates run a business selling access to the model as a service and their combined revenue tops $20 million over any 12 consecutive months, with exclusions for features embedded in end-user products and for relaying requests, and exemptions for internal use and certain official or certified access. Refusal, the model's trained habit of declining harmful requests, is the second. The third, which both labs now emphasize, is to withhold the training material that teaches the skill, to reduce the capability itself rather than relying only on refusal behavior.

Refusal proved vulnerable in tests by FAR.AI, an AI-safety research group, which probed K3.1 Pro's safeguards with requests for help with chemical, biological, nuclear and explosive weapons or with cyberattacks. Asked directly, the model complied 0.3% of the time. When testers used an output-prefill attack, writing the opening words of the model's answer so that it simply carries on, compliance rose to as much as 99%. The figures combine weapons and cyber requests, count the best of five attempts and were scored by automated graders, and a harmful answer is a long way from a completed intrusion. Even so, these results show a bypass of refusal behavior; they do not show that the training-data restrictions can be reversed.

Moonshot's internal evaluation measures how much exploit capability the restricted model retains; it does not measure how hard the restriction would be to reverse. Its benchmark, xdev-bench-hard, is an internal test that the company built and graded itself, with three attempts per task and no hard limit on time or output. On it, the released model still solves 81% of exploitation tasks; K3, an earlier Kimi model, solved about a third. Moonshot describes its policy as staying below the absolute frontier of cyber capability while raising the capability available in open weights over time, and the figures fit that description: the restricted model is far better at exploitation than its predecessor and somewhat worse than it could have been.

How long that gap lasts once the model reaches determined users is less clear. Audn.AI, an AI security firm, says an unrestricted derivative of K3.1 Pro solved eight of ten tasks from CyberGym, a cyber-security benchmark, and that a version it trained further on 382 gigabytes of its own offensive-security data solved nine. Ten tasks are too few to settle much, and the results have not been independently checked; nothing shows that the retrained model regained exactly what Moonshot removed. The direction, though, matches the Australian warning. A lab controls what its model learns before release, and anyone with the weights, suitable data and enough computing power can teach it more afterward.

The released model has competitive general scores, but those scores do not measure the cost of the cyber restrictions. Moonshot reports 65.7% for K3.1 Pro on Terminal-Bench 4.0, a test of carrying out programming tasks through a computer's command line, against 66.4% for Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 and 58.2% for OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra, all figures the company chose to present. Artificial Analysis, an independent benchmarking firm, gives the model 46 on its composite Intelligence Index but rates it comparatively expensive and slow among open-weight rivals, at about $3.7 and 40 minutes per task in its tests. Moonshot's own hosted service charges by the token: $2 per million tokens of input and $10 per million of output, a third below its listed K3 rates.

The retrieved evaluations do not isolate what the cyber restrictions cost. Artificial Analysis gives K3.1 Pro 64 on its independent Cyber Index, which covers finding, reproducing and patching vulnerabilities, the work that companies' security teams pay for, but it does not compare otherwise matched restricted and unrestricted checkpoints. Security work and attack work overlap: writing a proof-of-concept exploit is often how a defender shows that a flaw is real. Tencent says Hy4 retains proof-of-concept development, the fixing of vulnerabilities, and reverse engineering and penetration testing (authorized mock attacks on a system) for analysis, while excluding material on offensive exploitation.

Moonshot reports reduced exploit-test performance, while Tencent describes selective training restrictions without comparative cyber scores, and separate coding scores do not isolate what the restrictions cost in usefulness. The retrieved evidence does not establish that the reduction lasts after further training, or that it has prevented any real attack. Tencent has promised system cards, but its launch announcement supplies no numerical cyber results.

cross_cutting.description: Two months ago, Roman Ugarte, product lead of Grok Bot ... and explained how a small team of only a few people built the internal prototype of an AI product from scratch in about a month, and then launched it to the public in just three weeks?
cross_cutting.content:
# Grok Bot 1.0 is here: Why is "fewer buttons" actually a product improvement?

纪源资本2026-11-16 10:58

Adding things to the product is not the goal.

On the early morning of November 12, Grok Bot ushered in the official release of its 1.0 formal version.

As a major iteration, this AI Agent, which already has the capability to independently operate computers and execute tasks on behalf of users, has added several new features in this update: it can proactively identify to-do items, participate in team meetings, record colleagues' work habits, and even call other Bots to work together to complete tasks.

Two months ago, Roman Ugarte, product lead of Grok Bot, participated in a podcast recording. On the show, he reviewed the development experience of Grok Bot, and explained how a small team of only a few people built the internal prototype of an AI product from scratch in about a month, and then launched it to the public in just three weeks?

The most noteworthy part of this interview is that Roman, who was once in charge of Cursor's growth, shared how they re-understand AI products: How many execution details should users see? Why does every Bot need its own computer? When the model becomes more and more powerful, how to make trade-offs for the already completed features?

One judgment runs through the whole conversation:

Letting AI complete 100% of the work and letting it complete 90% bring two completely different experiences.

This time, we sorted out Roman's key statements in the interview, starting from the development experience of Grok Bot, to see what changes an AI product that makes ordinary people willing to hand over their work needs to make.

The following are thoughts from six directions:

## A small team starting from scratch,

## may be more efficient

The initial goal of Grok Bot is very clear: to bring the Agent capabilities that engineers have already used to other knowledge workers.

To this end, a small team of only a few people moved to a separate area in the office, used a separate Slack channel, and started development from a blank slate. About a month later, they came up with an internally available prototype.

Roman believes that such speed is closely related to team size and working method. During the development process, a large number of small decisions need to be made every day. If everything has to go through a wider range of discussion and coordination, it is difficult to find the direction of the product so quickly.

But the fact that the team is willing to use it themselves is only the first step. They are familiar with the mechanism of the product and know what it is good at. The real test is to hand it over to other departments of the company to see if those who did not participate in the development are willing to put down their original tools.

The positive feedback brought by internal trials allowed the team to start preparing for the public release. From the internal prototype to public availability, they spent about three more weeks.

Another important choice was to redesign the entry point for new users.

The team discussed whether it was possible to directly integrate the capabilities of Grok Bot into Cursor.

But in the end they gave up the idea. Because they felt that the interface and brand perception of engineering tools would create a sense of distance for non-technical users. Continuously adding tabs in the same interface will also easily crowd several different sets of product logic together.

Facing new users, the previously finished product is not necessarily the most suitable starting point. In the end, they chose to start from scratch.

## Without bias and preset assumptions,

## observe real user scenarios

Before the public release, the team personally guided two to three hundred users to get started in two weeks.

Initially, the user onboarding experience was not smooth. Sometimes the cloud computer failed to start for a long time, and team members could only awkwardly wait with the user on the call for twenty minutes. Such experiences made it impossible for problems to be easily put aside: since they would guide another person to use it the next day, they had to find a way to fix it today. User feedback thus became something that had to be resolved immediately.

Outside the company, the team also intentionally looked for users from non-technology industries. A coffee shop owner provided a lot of feedback. The Shopify connection problems and product copywriting problems he encountered when running his small business were very different from the demands put forward by internal employees. These business scenarios made up for the perspective that internal team trials could not provide.

These feedbacks reminded the team that to make non-developers use Grok Bot well, they must observe what tasks users need to complete in their actual work scenarios.

Such an observation process requires great restraint.

For example, during internal trials, some people would divide and manage their multiple Bots, promote the best-performing one to "Chief of Staff", and let it be responsible for assigning work to other Bots. Although this is a very good usage, the team did not guide external users to do the same at the beginning, but observed whether users would also figure out similar collaboration methods on their own. After seeing that external users did use it in this way, they began to encourage it appropriately.

Observe users without preset assumptions, and let users test the product in real use, which can become the basis for product design.

## Removing a few buttons,

## is also a kind of progress

Two weeks before the launch, Grok Bot still retained many experimental features, as well as content that facilitated developers to debug and troubleshoot.

These features are useful for the development team, but they may not be worth occupying the user's attention. Before the public release, an important task was to re-judge: what exactly do users need to see?

The principle Roman gave is very straightforward: "Adding things to the product is not the goal."

For example, after the user assigns a task, the Bot starts to execute, shows an active status, and reports progress at the right time. But users do not need to watch every tool call or every web page click.

As a result, the internal discussion of the team also shifted from "what new features has Grok Bot added" to "what can Grok Bot do now".

Take daily reminders as an example. In the past, software usually required users to open the sidebar, add automation, and then select trigger conditions and execution actions. Grok Bot hopes that users only need to say "Remind me at eight o'clock every morning", and the rest will be arranged by the system. Roman said in the interview that 99% of the automations on the platform today are built through natural language in this way.

A capability can exist in the background without having a dedicated button. Users learn one less operation, but can still complete the same work, which in itself is the progress of the product.

## Excellent experience,

## lies in the "colleague sense" of the product

When making decisions on product solutions, Roman and his team often ask: If the person opposite is a real human colleague, how do we want to cooperate with them? Two early key decisions of Grok Bot: tasks run in the cloud, and each Bot has its own computer, both follow this line of thinking.

Running in the cloud means that users do not need to judge whether their devices are turned on, nor do they have to worry about multi-device synchronization issues. Just like no matter which entrance you contact a colleague from, you can continue to advance the previous work.

Only by letting the Bot have its own computer can it use tools independently like a real human. Even if many tools do not have perfect interfaces and protocols, the Bot can still open pages, click buttons, enter information, and enter the real business process.

Roman used the metaphor of a new employee joining the company: the team usually equips new colleagues with a computer, and rarely asks them to sit beside them forever and share the same laptop. Bots also need their own working environment.

One step further, it is necessary to let the Bot take charge of a type of work for a long time.

When people use AI products, opening a new conversation every time they do something often means that materials need to be re-copied, and background information needs to be re-explained. But when working with real human colleagues, responsibilities are usually divided, letting the other party continuously be responsible for a certain field and accumulate experience in collaboration. Therefore, Grok Bot also tries to organize work in a similar way, allowing different Bots to retain their respective contexts and gradually get familiar with user requirements.

Roman's own test Bot even installed Grok Bot. When testing the new version of the desktop application, it will check the ten specified workflows, write the results into Notion, and then compare them with historical records. As the version is updated, the same Bot continues to take on this responsibility, and the test results can also be accumulated.

In the interview, Roman repeatedly used the expressions "colleague" and "teammate" to describe AI. Using Bots like collaborating with colleagues and handing over more long-term responsibilities to AI may help users reduce the burden of repeatedly explaining background information and handling trivial matters, leaving energy for more important judgments and communications.

## Build an AI product that truly lets users put down their work

What made Roman have strong confidence in non-programming Agents is an experience that allows users to temporarily put down tasks: explain the background clearly, leave for a while, and when you come back, the work is already done.

This is very different from the familiar way of using AI. In the past, us
